one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个融合决策模型与知识图谱的多智能体推荐框架，在稀疏数据场景下显著提升了推荐准确性。

title: Conditional information Retrieval for Longitudinal Survey Harmonisation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26173v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Identifying conceptually equivalent questions across different surveys is a challenging information retrieval task where surface-level textual similarity is insufficient. Two questions may be lexically similar yet assess entirely different sociological sub-concepts, or lexically different yet conceptually equivalent. We introduce a conditional information retrieval framework that addresses this by decomposing the task into two steps: concept extraction, which identifies the underlying sociological concept of a survey question using a fine-tuned generative model, and concept-aware retrieval, which augments question representations with the extracted concept as an explicit conditioning signal for finer-grained alignment. To reflect the realistic data scarcity conditions of specialised social science annotation, we use CLOSER as a case study. Our framework consistently outperforms baselines by 2-3 points in both MAP and Recall. We further analyse fine-tuning strategies including SFT, DPO, and dynamic DPO, finding that SFT delivers the most stable gains while dynamic DPO interacts differently with instruction-tuned versus distilled reasoning backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that a model fine-tuned on a general social science thesaurus (ELSST) transfers robustly to task-specific survey data, offering a practical solution under data scarcity.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种条件信息检索框架，用于解决跨调查问卷的概念对齐问题，通过结合概念提取和概念感知检索，在数据稀缺场景下提升了检索性能。其方法创新性强，并进行了细致的实验分析，但作为预印本，其实际在图书馆或信息机构中的落地应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种结合概念提取的两阶段检索框架，能更准确地匹配不同调查中概念相同但表述不同的问题。

title: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26310v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于语言模型代理在异步信息检索中的证据获取行为，通过引入并验证汇流证据获取（CEA）方法，有效减少了因异步性导致的决策分歧，方法设计严谨且实验充分。但研究场景较为特定，对图书馆等实际业务的直接应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现异步信息检索会显著影响语言模型代理的决策，并提出一种新方法能有效减少决策分歧，提升响应效率。

title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26339v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved three of four model configurations across the external benchmarks, with mean gains of up to 9.6 percentage points, and improved all four configurations on the held-out test set by 10.2-30.3 points. Abstract retrieval performed best when reference evidence was abstract-aligned, whereas full-text representations were generally more effective when richer evidence was needed. Hierarchical representation matched or outperformed flat full-text retrieval in most end-to-end comparisons while requiring 67% fewer indexed units and 44-56% less storage. These findings show that corpus scale should be treated as an explicit evaluation variable in biomedical RAG, and that the most appropriate design depends on evidence format, model behavior, and operational constraints.
thinking: 该论文通过大规模实验系统评估了生物医学领域RAG系统的关键影响因素，包括语料库规模、文档表示形式和重排序策略，研究设计严谨且具有明确的工程指导意义。然而，论文主要基于现有技术（如RAG、重排序）进行组合与优化，在技术原创性上有所不足，且其结论高度聚焦于生物医学领域，对其他图情场景的普适性有待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，生物医学问答系统的性能受语料库规模、文档表示形式（摘要或全文）和检索效率的共同影响，最优设计需根据具体场景权衡。

title: The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26433v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.
thinking: 该论文采用几何特征分析代理记忆检索失败，方法设计严谨，通过多数据集验证了嵌入空间距离与答案正确性的关联。然而，其预测性能未显著超越基线，且明确指出了几何特征无法区分错误类型，因此实际部署诊断价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，对话、记忆和查询文本在嵌入空间中的几何关系对答案正确性的预测能力有限，无法可靠用于实际系统诊断。

title: Beyond Behavioral Accuracy: Evaluating Individual-Level Fidelity in LLM Investor Simulation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26524v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as user simulators, but can they faithfully reproduce an individual's behavior and decision logic over time? We investigate this question in a longitudinal paper-trading study with 80 participants. Using rolling next-day predictions, we evaluate trading activity, buy-sell structure, asset selection, and portfolio outcomes, complemented by controlled input ablations and participant-rated explanation alignment. No evaluated LLM reliably outperforms a simple recent-activity persistence baseline for predicting trade occurrence, while buy-sell structure and asset selection remain difficult to reproduce. Similar activity-level performance can also yield substantially different portfolio trajectories. Ablations show that activity predictions depend primarily on recent trades, whereas asset choices are sensitive to multiple evidence sources. Participants rate explanations as more aligned with their recurring strategies than with their decision-specific rationales. These findings reveal a gap between coarse behavioral agreement and individual-level fidelity, motivating separate evaluation of behavioral accuracy, explanation alignment, and evidence dependence in personalized user simulation.
thinking: 该论文采用纵向实验设计，通过滚动预测、控制变量消融和参与者评分等方法，系统评估了LLM在模拟个体投资者行为时的保真度，方法严谨。其核心发现揭示了行为准确性与个体层面保真度之间的差距，对个性化用户模拟的评估框架有理论贡献，但作为一项基础性验证研究，其直接应用于图书馆等业务场景的路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，大语言模型在模拟个体投资者行为时，其整体行为准确度与真实反映个人决策逻辑的保真度之间存在显著差距。

title: Next Best Action: Causal Constrained Offline RL for Business Action Targeting
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26817v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Next Best Action (NBA) systems must select among customer interventions (e.g., discounts, promotions, and lifecycle actions), maximize long-term economic value, satisfy complex operational constraints, and remain causally grounded. Existing approaches lack a rigorous framework for meeting these requirements jointly. We address this gap by formulating NBA as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP). We then integrate off-policy causal correction of the estimated customer dynamics directly into the Linear Programming (LP) formulation of the CMDP. The resulting policy selects actions based on customer states to maximize long-term value while explicitly enforcing business guardrails. Furthermore, the LP formulation yields shadow prices that quantify the economic trade-offs of operational constraints (e.g., fairness and user welfare), enhancing policy interpretability. We validate our proposed offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework on an industry case study involving rideshare coupon targeting, where customer states are defined by Recency, Frequency, and Monetary (RFM) stages. We evaluate performance using model-based off-policy evaluation, with causal dynamics estimated from a temporal holdout. Under the observed coupon budget and RFM state representation, our optimized policy improves customer lifetime value (LTV) by 19% over the estimated behavior policy and 8% over a myopic baseline. Although the demonstrated action space is binary, the proposed framework is action-agnostic, yielding a general-purpose decision module for targeting systems that manage multiple interventions.
thinking: 该论文将强化学习与因果推断结合，提出了一种用于业务决策的约束离线强化学习框架，方法具有前沿性和严谨性。其核心贡献在于通过线性规划形式直接整合因果校正与业务约束，并提供了可解释的约束权衡分析。然而，其应用场景（如网约车优惠券）虽具有商业价值，但直接移植到图书馆等传统图情业务场景的路径尚不明确，实践应用价值相对间接。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种结合因果推断与约束强化学习的新框架，用于优化商业场景下的“下一步最佳行动”决策，在案例中显著提升了客户长期价值。

title: Chain of Retrieval: Multi-Aspect Iterative Search Expansion and Post-Order Search Aggregation for Full Paper Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2507.10057v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Scientific paper retrieval, particularly framed as document-to-document retrieval, aims to identify relevant papers in response to a long-form query paper, rather than a short query string. Previous approaches to this task have largely focused on abstracts, embedding them into dense vectors as surrogates for full documents and calculating similarity between them. Yet, abstracts offer only sparse and high-level summaries, and such methods primarily optimize one-to-one similarity, overlooking the dynamic relations that emerge across relevant papers during the retrieval process. To address this, we propose Chain of Retrieval (CoR), a novel iterative framework for full-paper retrieval. Specifically, CoR decomposes each query paper into multiple aspect-specific views, matches them against segmented candidate papers, and iteratively expands the search by promoting top-ranked results as new queries, thereby forming a tree-structured retrieval process. The resulting retrieval tree is then aggregated in a post-order manner: descendants are first combined at the query level, then recursively merged with their parent nodes, to capture hierarchical relations across iterations. To validate this, we present SciFullBench, a large-scale benchmark providing both complete and segmented contexts of full papers for queries and candidates, and results show that CoR significantly outperforms existing retrieval baselines. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/psw0021/Chain-of-Retrieval-Official.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于多视角迭代检索与后序聚合的全文检索框架，在方法上具有创新性，并构建了大规模基准数据集进行验证，技术前沿度较高。该方法主要面向学术文献检索场景，对图书馆和学术搜索引擎有潜在应用价值，但尚未在实际系统中部署验证。实验设计较为严谨，但未详细讨论计算开销和实际部署的可行性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过分解论文多视角并迭代检索、后序聚合的新方法，显著提升了全文科学论文检索的效果。

title: NextAds: Towards Next-generation Personalized Video Advertising
abstract:
arXiv:2603.02137v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: With the rapid growth of online video consumption, video advertising has become increasingly dominant in the digital advertising landscape. Yet diverse users and viewing contexts make one-size-fits-all ad creatives insufficient for consistent effectiveness, underlining the importance of personalization. In practice, most personalized video advertising systems follow a retrieval-based paradigm, selecting the optimal one from a small set of professionally pre-produced creatives for each user. Such static and finite inventories limit both the granularity and the timeliness of personalization, and prevent the creatives from being continuously refined based on online user feedback. Recent advances in generative AI make it possible to move beyond retrieval toward optimizing video creatives in a continuous space at serving time.
  In this light, we propose NextAds, a generation-based paradigm for next-generation personalized video advertising. We articulate its key principles and conceptualize an agentic workflow for closed-loop creative optimization, spanning planning, generation, verification, and reflection. We further explore how personalized creatives can evolve across impressions through feedback-driven refinement and progressive storytelling. To further ground this vision, we formalize two representative tasks and conduct exploratory experiments on corresponding lightweight benchmarks, revealing both the promise and limitations of existing GenAI. Moreover, we discuss potential research opportunities and the broader implications of increasingly personalized and native advertising, highlighting issues that warrant attention from the community and aiming to provide insights for future research and responsible deployment. Our code, benchmarks, and demonstrations are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/NextAdsProjectPage/.
thinking: 该论文探讨了生成式AI在视频广告个性化中的应用，提出了从检索式向生成式范式转变的框架，技术前沿性突出，并设计了概念验证性实验。然而，其研究目前主要停留在概念阐述和初步实验阶段，缺乏在真实广告投放系统中的大规模验证，因此业务落地价值和方法的严谨性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种利用生成式AI实现动态、闭环优化的新一代个性化视频广告系统框架。

title: Your Embedding Model is SMARTer Than You Think
abstract:
arXiv:2605.24938v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multimodal retrieval relies heavily on single-vector retrievers, which compress rich, sequential token sequences into one single global representation. While efficient, they discard fine-grained, local evidence critical for dense retrieval tasks. Multi-vector approaches were introduced as a solution, but they strictly require training and many ignore the necessity of a globally summarizing representation. To address this, we introduce SMART, a framework that unlocks the latent multi-vector capabilities of standard single-vector models. We first observe that gradients from the pooled contrastive objective reach the preceding hidden states, and then show empirically that these states are already organized for cosine-based matching. By applying direct late-interaction over these frozen hidden states during inference, SMART acts as a plug-and-play upgrade that consistently improves performance across diverse modalities, improving even the state-of-the-art models further on MMEB-V2. We also show that lightweight post-training saves time and compute while further improving Visual Document retrieval, allowing a single-vector model to perform competitively with SoTA multi-vector counterparts. SMART targets dense retrieval: its gains concentrate on fine-grained and visual-document tasks, it is on par on global tasks such as classification, and it trades additional per-token index storage for these gains. Ultimately, SMART offers both a highly efficient inference enhancement and a powerful finetuning technique for multimodal retrieval. We open source our code and weights at https://github.com/HanSolo9682/SMART.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种名为SMART的框架，能够解锁标准单向量嵌入模型的潜在多向量检索能力，方法新颖且无需重新训练，具有显著的技术创新性。其研究基于梯度分析和实验验证，方法严谨，并在多模态检索基准上取得了性能提升，具有较好的实践应用潜力，尤其是在视觉文档检索等细粒度任务上。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需重新训练即可增强现有单向量嵌入模型检索性能的通用框架，在细粒度多模态检索任务上效果显著。

title: Subtraction Gets You More: Gap-Aware Retrieval for Multimodal Multi-Hop QA
abstract:
arXiv:2605.28641v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: In multimodal multi-hop question answering, we focus on the initial retrieval stage via two distinct tasks: (1) evidence set completion, retrieving missing evidence given context, and (2) sequential pool construction, iteratively building the top-$K$ pool from the scratch. Under these settings, we point out that conventional iterative retrieval frameworks often suffer from Semantic Anchoring, where previously fetched evidence traps the retriever and yields entity-centric redundancy. To break this trap, we propose GRAIL (Gap-aware Retrieval via Adaptive Implicit Localization), a paradigm that performs implicit query rewriting directly at the embedding level. By context-subtractive query steering, GRAIL excels at compositional cross-modal reasoning, while additive embedding updates show strength on localized information aggregation. To leverage these complementary strengths, we propose a Task-Adaptive Hybrid Framework, achieving a 35.7% macro-averaged performance gain on the MultimodalQA evidence set completion task. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that sequential GRAIL retrieves in a superior, noise-resilient manner, significantly expanding the search horizon through iterative gap-aware optimization.
thinking: 论文提出了GRAIL方法，通过嵌入层面的隐式查询重写解决多模态多跳问答中的语义锚定问题，方法新颖且实验设计较为严谨。但作为arXiv预印本，其方法在真实图书馆或信息检索系统中的落地路径尚不明确，且发布日期为未来日期，需谨慎评估其实际成熟度。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种通过嵌入向量相减来避免冗余、提升多模态多跳问答检索效果的新方法。

title: GenPage: Towards End-to-End Generative Homepage Construction at Netflix
abstract:
arXiv:2606.31031v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: We present GenPage, an end-to-end generative approach to Netflix homepage construction that replaces the traditional multi-stage recommender stack with a single transformer. GenPage treats the user and request context as a prompt and autoregressively generates the entire structured, multi-row homepage as the response. We adapt the LLM training recipe: pretraining on production pages, followed by post-training via weighted binary classification (WBC) or reinforcement learning (RL). For industry-scale deployment, we introduce techniques addressing cold start, model freshness, business-rule enforcement, and serving efficiency. In online A/B tests against a mature, highly optimized production homepage recommender, GenPage delivered a substantial lift on the core user engagement metric we use for launch decisions, while reducing end-to-end serving latency by 20%. Offline, two findings stand out: enriching the prompt yields a larger improvement than scaling model capacity in our current regime, and RL post-training increases homepage diversity even though diversity is not part of the objective.
thinking: 该论文提出了GenPage，一种基于Transformer的端到端生成式主页构建方法，在Netflix的实际生产环境中替代了传统的多阶段推荐系统栈。其优势在于成功进行了在线A/B测试，显著提升了核心用户参与度指标并降低了延迟，具有明确的工业落地价值；其方法也较为严谨，涵盖了预训练、后训练、冷启动等工程挑战。不足在于，虽然采用了前沿的生成式AI技术，但其核心仍是特定业务场景下的优化，技术原理的创新性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: Netflix提出并成功上线了一种用单个Transformer模型直接生成整个个性化主页的新方法，显著提升了用户参与度并降低了系统延迟。

title: Reproducing LightMem: When Does Memory Construction Help Over Raw-Turn Retrieval?
abstract:
arXiv:2607.29104v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Long-term conversational agents require access to information from earlier interactions, such as a user's preferences, past requests, or previously mentioned facts. Repeatedly providing the full dialogue history can be expensive as conversations grow, so many memory approaches instead transform past interactions into compact entries that can be retrieved when needed. LightMem is a recent lightweight memory-management approach that reports strong effectiveness while maintaining relatively low construction cost. However, it still relies on a separate constructed memory representation and is evaluated with only one retriever, leaving unclear how sensitive its results are to retriever choice and whether memory construction provides sufficient benefits over retrieving directly from raw turns.
  In this study, we reproduce LightMem and compare it with Naive RAG, which retrieves directly from raw user turns. We recover LightMem's main configuration trend, but find that retriever choice substantially affects answer accuracy: changing only the retriever over a fixed LightMem store shifts answer accuracy from 58.1\% to 75.5\%. Retrieval over constructed memory also does not consistently outperform raw-turn retrieval. At matched retrieval depths, Naive RAG generally achieves higher answer accuracy, whereas LightMem has an advantage under tight answering-token budgets. Oracle-reference evaluation further suggests that memory construction may omit or alter answer-relevant information.
  Overall, LightMem provides a conditional context-efficiency advantage rather than a consistent answer accuracy advantage over Naive RAG. Strong retrieval over raw turns can match or outperform constructed memory as the answering-token budget increases, motivating future work on retrieval, reranking, query formulation, and their interaction with raw-turn and constructed memory representations.
thinking: 该论文对LightMem这一对话系统记忆构建方法进行了严谨的复现与对比研究，通过控制变量（如检索器、检索深度、回答token预算）进行了系统性评估，方法规范且论证扎实。其核心发现——记忆构建的优势是条件性的，且原始对话轮次的检索性能常可与之匹敌——对优化检索式对话代理的工程实践具有直接指导意义，但所涉技术本身（记忆构建与检索）并非当前最前沿的突破。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在对话系统中，对原始对话记录进行直接检索的效果往往不亚于构建专用记忆库，后者仅在回答长度受限时具有优势。

title: Is Serving-Time Language-Model Inference Necessary for Recommendation? Evidence from Generative and Agentic Settings
abstract:
arXiv:2608.01260v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used in recommender systems to generate recommendations or coordinate recommendation tools. However, does their strong performance imply that serving-time LM inference is necessary? We challenge this seemingly reasonable but unverified assumption. To investigate this question, we introduce recovery-based mechanism auditing, which tests whether independent alternatives can achieve the accuracy of LM-based recommender systems without the audited inference mechanisms under controlled information and evaluation conditions. For generative recommendation, we propose LIME-Rec, which combines sequential, collaborative, and offline semantic information without autoregressive LM decoding. On three Amazon Reviews datasets (Beauty, Toys, and Sports), LIME-Rec achieves the highest reported mean in all 12 dataset-metric combinations, with up to a 15.2% relative improvement in Recall@10 over GRAM, an LM-based generative recommender. For agentic recommendation, we propose DART-Rec, which replaces LM-based tool control with deterministic fusion and fixed expert selection. On 1,000 Beauty users, given the same candidate items and expert scores, deterministic fusion achieves a 16.7% relative improvement in Recall@10 over a fine-tuned LM controller. With at most two tool calls, fixed expert selection matches the LM controllers' Hit@10 outcomes for every user in 17 of 18 comparisons. These findings demonstrate that strong recommendation performance does not necessarily require serving-time LM inference: under the evaluated task and information conditions, alternatives without the specified inference mechanisms can match or exceed the accuracy of their LM-based counterparts. To support reproducibility, code is available at https://github.com/Double-wk/LIME-Rec.
thinking: 该论文通过严谨的对比实验，挑战了推荐系统中必须使用大语言模型进行在线推理的普遍假设，并提出了有效的替代方案，方法设计规范，结论具有启发性。其不足在于实验数据集较为单一，主要基于电商评论数据，在其他推荐场景下的普适性有待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在特定条件下，无需使用大语言模型进行在线推理，通过更简单的替代方法也能实现同等甚至更优的推荐效果。

title: Making Collaborative Signals Count: Graph-Aware Large Language Models for Sequential Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2608.12184v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted as backbones for recommender systems. However, their language-centric pretraining makes it difficult to capture collaborative signals implicit in user-item interactions, which are crucial for personalized recommendation. Existing methods either inject collaborative representations produced by external recommenders or model only intra-sequence dependencies, limiting their ability to exploit global collaborative patterns. To address this limitation, we propose GALLM, a graph-aware LLM framework for sequential recommendation. GALLM constructs a collaborative graph over text tokens and item tokens, and models three types of relations: Text--Text relations for preserving semantic dependencies, Item--Text relations for aligning item tokens with their textual descriptions, and Item--Item relations derived from global item co-occurrence patterns. These relations are transformed into lightweight learnable attention biases and incorporated into the LLM attention mechanism, enabling collaborative-aware token interactions without introducing an additional graph encoder. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that GALLM achieves the best performance among the compared baselines, improving over the strongest baseline by 9.76\% on average in HR@5. The code is available at https://github.com/Fenglin-miku/GALLM.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合图结构与大语言模型的序列推荐方法，通过构建文本与项目的协作图并设计轻量化的注意力偏置，有效弥补了语言模型在捕捉全局协作信号上的不足。实验在多个基准数据集上验证了其有效性，方法设计具有创新性且严谨，但其业务落地价值受限于对计算资源和数据标注的依赖。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种图感知大语言模型框架，通过融合全局项目共现模式来增强序列推荐的个性化效果。

title: P$^3$Rec: Distilling Prior--Posterior Preference Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2609.13993v4 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding and preference reasoning capabilities, offering new opportunities for user modeling in recommender systems. Existing LLM-as-Enhancer methods typically distill LLM-derived preference knowledge into lightweight recommenders to avoid costly online LLM inference. However, they often construct distillation knowledge from only one perspective. Prior preference captures users' stable and consistent interests but provides limited guidance for the current decision, whereas posterior preference reveals target-relevant fine-grained interests but may rely excessively on target clues. To address these limitations, we propose P$^3$Rec, a framework that jointly extracts and internalizes complementary prior and posterior preference reasoning knowledge. Specifically, P$^3$Rec first derives target-agnostic prior preferences and target-conditioned posterior preferences from the user side, while further extracting item-centric preference representations from item semantics and predecessor interactions. It then progressively internalizes prior and posterior knowledge into behavioral representations through prior preference absorption and posterior-guided preference distillation. Since the resulting comprehensive preference representation may not always provide an equally decisive retrieval direction, P$^3$Rec further characterizes historical interest dispersion with interest entropy and adaptively calibrates the user representation before contrastive retrieval optimization. In this way, P$^3$Rec achieves more complete preference reasoning while preserving efficient recommendation. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate its effectiveness.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合先验偏好与后验偏好的LLM知识蒸馏框架，在推荐系统领域具有明确的技术创新性，方法设计较为系统，并通过多数据集实验验证了有效性。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法严谨性（如实验可复现性、与工业级系统的对比）仍有待同行评议和实际部署的进一步检验，业务落地路径也需更具体的阐述。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新框架，通过联合蒸馏大语言模型的先验与后验偏好知识，以提升推荐系统的性能与效率。

title: Predictable Failure in Multi-Hop Retrieval: Score-Distributional Confidence Scoring and Abstention
abstract:
arXiv:2609.22056v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval failures are not uniformly distributed across queries: they cluster in structurally predictable subpopulations. We prove two results formalizing this structure. First (CWAR Reducibility): confident-failure reduction is achievable if and only if retrieval features carry mutual information about success, a condition satisfied by LLM-judge pipelines but substantially weaker in dense-only settings, explaining the AUC-AC gap between regimes. Second (Feature Regime Complementarity): no single ANN score feature achieves best predictive performance across all failure regimes; the dominant feature differs between datasets (query length on MuSiQue, hop-1 concentration on HoVer), and a constructive witness pair shows each is necessary in one regime and non-contributory in the other. We instantiate these principles in RegimeAbstain, which computes a Retrieval Confidence Score (RCS), a logistic function of up to nine query-ANN structural features, all available without any additional LLM call, and uses it to implement a calibrated abstention policy. We define the Confident-Wrong-Answer Rate (CWAR) metric and evaluate across three multi-hop benchmarks (MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HoVer) and two retrieval architectures (LLM-judge and dense-only), covering five failure regimes with CWAR from 14.5% to 62.1%. RCS achieves best or co-best AUC-AC in all five conditions against eight confidence baselines. On MuSiQue (LLM-judge), RCS reduces CWAR from 39.5% to 20.6% at 50% coverage (47.8% relative reduction), with ECE=0.035. A model trained on MuSiQue transfers to 2WikiMultiHopQA with only -0.5pp AUC loss, confirming the domain-agnostic structure of regime features.
thinking: 该论文通过理论证明和实验验证，揭示了多跳检索失败的结构性规律，并提出了一个无需额外LLM调用的、基于检索结构特征的置信度评分与弃权框架。其方法严谨，在多个基准测试中验证了有效性，但研究场景聚焦于特定检索架构下的失败预测，业务落地价值相对受限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现多跳检索失败具有结构性规律，并提出一种基于检索特征的置信度评分方法，能有效识别并主动放弃可能出错的查询。

title: Upgrade the Retriever First: What an LLM Call per Chunk Buys in RAG
abstract:
arXiv:2603.23533v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Many RAG pipelines pay one LLM call per chunk at indexing time to add titles, summaries, keywords and questions (enrichment) or document context (contextual retrieval, CR). We ask what that call buys over free structure and a better retriever. Our advice: upgrade the retriever first, chunk at headers, and enrich mainly for lexical retrieval. Under a plan made public before any index was built, 7B enrichment beats a free section-path prefix under a hybrid retriever by +5.5 recall points on Qasper; on FreshStack its gain (+2.7) does not survive Holm adjustment. It is equivalent to CR, which sends 5.8-8.7 times the input tokens, and Qasper answer F1 (7B reader) is equivalent for both contrasts. Header-led chunks beat 512-character windows; on FreshStack they lose to overlapping 256-token windows. Under qwen3-embedding and a reranker, the two strongest of eight retrievers (named as secondary before any outcome was computed), the CIs of 7B enrichment against the free prefix fall within the equivalence margins; under BM25 it gains +8.7. Exploratory analyses attribute the hybrid gain to document expansion and to repairing an untuned rank fusion; the free prefix under either strong retriever beats hybrid enrichment by +3.4 to +6.3 points, though the best 120B-indexed configuration leads the best free one by +2.5 on Qasper. Add-ons built on the call do no better than LLM-free controls, and late chunking lowers Qasper recall. We release the plan, harness and per-question results.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于RAG（检索增强生成）系统中的检索器优化策略，通过严谨的实验设计比较了不同检索增强方法的性能，技术方法前沿且实验设计规范。然而，其研究场景主要面向通用信息检索技术评估，与图书馆、信息机构等具体业务场景的直接关联性较弱，实践应用价值有待进一步转化。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在RAG系统中优先升级检索器并采用基于标题的文本分块策略，其效果优于为每个文本块调用大语言模型进行增强的常见做法。

title: Traceable Context-Enriched Knowledge Graph Generation with Induced Schemas
abstract:
arXiv:2604.03496v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Knowledge graph generation typically relies either on predefined ontologies or on schema-free extraction. Ontology-driven pipelines enforce consistent typing but require costly schema design and maintenance, whereas schema-free methods often produce fragmented graphs with weak global organization, especially in long technical documents with dense, context-dependent information. We propose \textbf{TRACE-KG} (Text-dRiven schemA for Context-Enriched Knowledge Graphs), a framework that jointly constructs a context-enriched knowledge graph and an induced schema without assuming a predefined ontology. TRACE-KG captures conditional relations through structured qualifiers and organizes entities and relations using a data-driven schema that serves as a reusable semantic scaffold while preserving full traceability to the source evidence. Experiments show that TRACE-KG produces structurally coherent, traceable knowledge graphs and offers a practical alternative to both ontology-driven and schema-free construction pipelines. The code, experiments and prompts are available at \url{https://github.com/mosadddeq01/TRACE-KG}.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种无需预定义本体即可联合构建知识图谱和诱导模式的框架，在方法上结合了结构化限定符和数据驱动模式，具有一定技术前沿性。其核心优势在于平衡了本体驱动与无模式方法的优缺点，提供了可追溯的构建流程，但实验部分未详细说明数据集规模和评估指标，方法严谨性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种能自动生成可追溯知识图谱及其语义模式的框架，无需依赖预先设计的本体。

title: CyberCane: a privacy-bounded neuro-symbolic retrieval framework for phishing detection under distribution shift
abstract:
arXiv:2604.23563v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Organizations usually calibrate phishing detectors on public corpora, because privacy rules make their own labeled legitimate mail hard to collect. This practice breaks the false-positive budget of trained detectors: calibrated for a 1% false-positive rate (FPR) on older public mail and deployed on DataPhish 2025, they realize 20.2-22.9% FPR, 9-94 times the budget across three calibration sources. The cause is calibration transfer, not ranking: the classifiers separate the deployment mail well, but their thresholds do not transfer. We introduce CyberCane, a privacy-bounded neuro-symbolic detector that scores email only by similarity to known phishing in a redacted, training-only index, plus deterministic rules, and calibrates verdicts to an explicit FPR budget. Because legitimate mail never enters its score, only its threshold depends on the calibration source. Under the same shift CyberCane realizes 5.4% FPR at 86.4% recall, reducing the overrun 2.7-6.1 times across sources, seeds, a second shift family, and a local embedder. A segment-level variant, scoring an email's most phishing-like part, lowers the realized FPR a further 1.2-2.7 times at equal ranking quality and withstands benign padding. CyberCane screens an email locally in 0.20 s, sending no text out; a 70B zero-shot LLM ranks better at strict FPR but is 14-24 times slower and must receive each email. We also show that LLM rewriting does not evade embedding-based detectors and that a random split of DataPhish 2025 leaks 96% of its test set. All protocols were fixed in advance, and the released splits and code let a deployer measure realized FPR before trusting a budget.
thinking: 论文提出了一种结合神经符号方法的隐私保护钓鱼邮件检测框架，其核心创新在于通过构建仅包含已知钓鱼邮件的索引来规避对合法邮件数据的依赖，从而解决因隐私限制导致的模型校准迁移问题。方法设计严谨，在模拟真实数据分布偏移的场景下进行了多角度验证，并公开了代码和数据集以支持复现，但研究场景较为特定，在图书馆业务中的直接应用场景有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的钓鱼邮件检测框架，通过仅依赖已知钓鱼样本进行相似度计算，有效解决了因数据隐私导致的模型性能在真实部署中严重下降的问题。

title: Leveraging Low-Level Symbolic Competences for Unsupervised Grounding in Hallucination Detection
abstract:
arXiv:2609.05025v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Hallucination-where a language model generates outputs that are factually incorrect or unsupported by the source-is a major challenge for both prompted and fine-tuned language models. Detecting hallucinations is difficult due to the opaque reasoning processes of LLMs, which often provide little insight into why a model's output may be inaccurate.
  In this work, we investigate whether an LLM can use an alternative, low level, symbolic competence such as SQL for unsupervised hallucination detection in some high level task. For this, we make an LLM build an SQL database from reference documents. This SQL database is then used for reasoning over the reference and the sampled response in a hallucination detection pipeline that is grounded in the database, thereby providing a neurosymbolic checkup.
  On RAGTruth and DiaHalu hallucination detection datasets, we find that our approach improves on direct prediction and competes with state-of-the-art hallucination detection methods, while not requiring domain-specific fine-tuning. Instead it relies on a low-level general competence already present in LLMs. This warrants further investigation of low-level LLM competences in neurosymbolic approaches.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合神经符号方法的幻觉检测新思路，利用LLM已有的SQL能力构建可验证的数据库，方法具有一定创新性。然而，该方法依赖于特定任务场景（需构建SQL数据库），在通用性上存在局限，且作为预印本论文，其方法细节和实验验证的完整性有待同行评议进一步确认。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出利用大语言模型自身的SQL能力来构建可验证数据库，以实现无需微调的神经符号幻觉检测方法。

title: Discuss More, Comment Less: Boosting Automated Research via Multi-Perspective Collaborative Review
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24050v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As automated research is increasingly adopted for writing papers, automated review has become a critical link between paper generation and quality control. However, existing methods largely rely on single-model feedback or simple review aggregation, failing to explicitly model expert responsibilities or collective deliberation in actual peer reviews, which limits effective cross-examination and reliable decision-making. Therefore, we formulate paper review as a computational modeling problem of peer review mechanisms and propose RoundtableReview, a deliberative multi-agent framework for enhancing automated research. RoundtableReview structures each paper into eight semantic slots and coordinates six academic and industry reviewers with complementary perspectives, retrieval sources, and specialized responsibilities. Through independent assessment, cross-examination, roundtable deliberation, dynamically weighted voting, and chair synthesis, the framework generates evidence-based and traceable feedback. Experiments on two automated research backbones show that the method improves paper quality in both backbones and outperforms baselines in automatic and human evaluations with fewer comments.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个基于多智能体协同审稿的自动化研究增强框架，在方法上具有创新性，通过模拟真实同行评审的独立评估、交叉质询和集体审议机制来提升生成论文的质量，属于前沿探索。其实验设计较为严谨，在两个自动化研究骨干网络上进行了验证，并采用了自动和人工评估相结合的方式，但作为预印本论文，其具体实现细节和在实际学术出版流程中的落地可行性仍需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个模拟真实同行评审流程的多智能体框架，通过结构化审稿和集体审议来提升自动化生成学术论文的质量。

title: Do LMs Know What Variables Do? Interpreting Code Representations via Variable Roles
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24118v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Variable roles describe recurring behaviors such as accumulation, traversal, and retaining the best candidate encountered. We use Sajaniemi's independently defined taxonomy to study which role distinctions can be recovered from large language models, how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) retain those distinctions, and whether associated directions support control of generation. We introduce static annotation rules for all eleven roles and a corpus of 126,926 natural-code files across five languages. Across five model-SAE systems, residual probes outperform individual SAE features and tested lexical baselines, with modest losses after neutral target renaming. Combining SAE features closes much of the single-feature gap, but probes on SAE reconstructions are less sensitive to role-changing edits reviewed by LLMs. High paired ranking accuracy coexists with frequent false positives at fixed thresholds. During generation, interventions often change role annotations at the cost of correctness; changes accompanied by passing tests show no clear aggregate advantage over random controls. The benchmark separates role-related recoverability, SAE fidelity, and correctness-preserving control through matched prediction, source edits, and generation interventions.
thinking: 该论文采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）和残差探针等前沿技术分析大语言模型对变量角色的理解能力，技术方法较为先进；研究构建了大规模多语言代码语料库并设计了系统的评估框架，方法严谨性较高；但其研究结论指出干预生成常以牺牲代码正确性为代价，直接业务落地价值有限，主要贡献在于模型可解释性方法论层面。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过大规模实验发现，大语言模型能部分识别代码中的变量角色，但通过干预模型内部表示来控制代码生成往往会破坏代码的正确性。

title: BanglaShield: A Script-Robust Safety Classifier and Benchmark for Bangla Native, Romanized, and Code-Mixed Prompts
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24288v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety classifiers for large language models (LLMs) are typically built and evaluated on standard-script text, yet Bangla, like many lower-resource languages, is routinely written in native script, in Latin-script romanization, and code-mixed with English, Hindi, or Urdu. We introduce BanglaShield, a resource and model for graded prompt-safety classification across these written forms. We consolidate 10,245 Bangla prompts from six sources under a four-level taxonomy (Safe, Offensive, Harmful, Severe) and render each prompt in three aligned forms that share labels and a group-aware split, enabling strictly paired comparisons. Benchmarking six contemporary LLMs, including a Bangla-specialized one, on 36,882 classification queries and 24,318 judged responses, we find that LLM classifiers label 47.0% of unsafe native-script prompts as Safe, rising to 63.4% under romanization, while response-level safety accuracy drops by 10.3 points. Three multilingual guard models also pass 30.3-57.3% of unsafe native-script prompts. Using a model's own classification as an input filter reduces harmful compliance by only about five points. In contrast, BanglaShield, a compact fine-tuned encoder, reaches 87.8 macro-F1 on native-script and 84.4 on romanized prompts, outperforming the best LLM on each form by 42.8-46.1 points with ~130x fewer parameters than Gemma 4 31B. We release the corpus, splits, judgments, and model.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于低资源语言孟加拉语的安全分类问题，创新性地构建了包含原生、罗马化和混合脚本的基准数据集与分类模型，技术方法具有前沿性。研究通过严格的实验设计对比了多种大语言模型，方法严谨，其构建的轻量级分类器在特定场景下具有直接的应用潜力，但业务落地范围可能主要限于相关语种的AI内容审核领域。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了首个覆盖孟加拉语多书写形式的基准数据集和安全分类模型，显著提升了低资源语言大模型内容审核的准确性。

title: Ben-Misandry: A Bengali Dataset and Late-Fusion Transformer Framework for Detecting Anti-Male Gender Hate
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24474v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Gender based hate speech research in Bengali has focused almost exclusively on misogyny, leaving anti male hate, or misandry, entirely unstudied for this language and creating a systematic blind spot in moderation systems trained to catch attacks on women but not on men. We introduce Ben-Misandry, the first Bengali misandry detection dataset: 5,000 comments across six taxonomy classes, including a novel category for mocking male emotional vulnerability with no direct analogue in existing misogyny taxonomies. The corpus is taxonomy-controlled synthetic data generated with GPT-4.1, spot-checked by four human reviewers on a 500-comment sample who confirmed the large majority of assigned labels; a full inter-annotator- agreement study is left to future work. We benchmark it with a classical pipeline (seven classifiers over four text representations) and a transformer pipeline (BanglaBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and two fusion strategies). The best classical model, a linear SVM over character-level TF-IDF, reaches 91.8% accuracy; a late fusion ensemble averaging BanglaBERT and XLM-RoBERTa softmax outputs reaches 96.6% accuracy and macro ROC-AUC above 99%, nominally ahead of every single model and early fusion, though we have not run significance testing to confirm these margins are meaningful. We relate this to classifier combination theory, under which averaging encoders with decorrelated errors is expected to reduce variance, and corroborate the decision boundary with Shapley explanations that recover the same class- discriminative vocabulary found in our exploratory analysis, while noting this cannot rule out the model partly keying on synthetic-generation artifacts. Our results indicate misandry detection in Bengali is feasible and measurable on this synthetic corpus, offered as an initial public resource pending validation on real-world data.
thinking: 该论文构建了首个孟加拉语反男性仇恨言论数据集，并采用基于Transformer的融合模型进行检测，在技术方法上具有前沿性。然而，数据集为GPT-4.1生成的合成数据，仅进行了有限的人工抽查，缺乏全面的真实数据验证和显著性检验，方法严谨性存在明显不足。其研究成果为孟加拉语内容审核提供了新工具，具有潜在应用价值，但需在真实场景中进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了首个孟加拉语反男性仇恨言论数据集，并通过融合Transformer模型实现了高精度检测。

title: Backend-Frontend Converter: Component-Based Conversion of .NET Computational Models to TypeScript
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24492v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Computational models developed in .NET often need to run locally within web applications. We present Backend--Frontend Converter, an architecture for generating TypeScript implementations of component-based models. The converter maps components, connections, aliases, and formula trees to model-specific TypeScript code. Reusable runtime libraries provide numerical integration, data access, and state handling. We evaluate stored generated implementations through four orbital scenarios and a recorded trading-strategy comparison. Orbital calculations execute in a browser and are paired with C\# results by crossing event and timestamp; trading outputs are aligned by date. Analytic scheduler tests and deliberately perturbed outputs assess the validation procedure. Each orbital scenario produces 91 paired events with identical timestamps. Position and velocity differences remain below $(10^{-6}\)~km$ and $(10^{-9}\)~km/s$. All 20 analytic scheduler checks pass, and the comparator detects each of three prescribed state and time perturbations. The trading comparison contains 501 aligned daily records with matching indicator values, positions, and order events. The evaluated implementations preserve the compared outputs across the C#/TypeScript boundary. Component-specific generation and reusable execution libraries provide a practical route from supported .NET computational models to TypeScript applications.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种将.NET计算模型转换为TypeScript的组件化架构，技术方案具体且具有创新性，但研究场景较为特定，在图书馆与信息科学领域的直接应用价值有限。方法验证通过多个场景和扰动测试，严谨性较高，但前沿性主要体现在软件工程层面，与图情领域的前沿技术结合不紧密。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种架构，能将.NET开发的组件化计算模型自动转换为可在浏览器中运行的TypeScript代码，并验证了转换的准确性。

title: Measuring Data Diversity with Embeddings: A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Diversity Measures
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24888v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diversity is a critical property of text corpora, with direct implications for training data curation, test set design, and model generalization. However, its measurement remains fragmented and poorly understood. Existing embedding-based diversity measures vary widely in how they are computed and can yield substantially different diversity scores on the same data, yet no systematic comparison of their empirical behaviour exists. We make two contributions toward addressing this gap. First, we present a taxonomy of 21 embedding-based diversity measures, organizing them into four families based on their underlying computations. Second, we introduce EmbDivBench, a benchmark that evaluates these measures along three conceptually distinct components (variety, balance and disparity) on both simulated and natural text data. Although Mean Pairwise Distance is the most commonly used measure, our experiments show that it is outperformed by several alternatives on the three diversity components, with Graph Entropy being the best choice overall. Lastly, we distil these findings into practical recommendations for diversity measure selection.
thinking: 该论文系统梳理了21种基于嵌入的多样性度量方法，并提出了包含三个维度的基准测试框架，方法严谨性较高。研究聚焦于NLP领域的数据多样性评估，技术前沿性较强，但直接面向图书馆或信息机构的业务落地场景有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究系统比较了多种文本数据多样性度量方法，发现图熵方法综合表现最优，并为方法选择提供了实用建议。

title: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25159v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: People ask conversational AI models about their legal rights, obligations, procedures, and personal situations that may have legal consequences. To study this behavior, we first need to distinguish requests for legal guidance from other legally themed discussions and unrelated conversations. We contribute a multi-axis taxonomy of legal queries capturing whether legal guidance is sought, how a request is formulated, and which legal domains it concerns; apply it to 2,122 naturally occurring WildChat-1M conversations; and create a human-reviewed gold evaluation set of 200 conversations. All annotations, model checkpoints, and evaluation code are publicly available. In this enriched sample, 71.1% of conversations containing legal content seek personalized or practical guidance. Rights-and-options advice is the most common primary request type among legal-content conversations, and 25.3% of guidance-positive conversations span multiple legal topics. The gold evaluation set supports a two-stage comparison of ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large against a TF-IDF cascade. Our framework supports large-scale studies of legal guidance in conversational AI, and the public release of the annotated data facilitates reproducible research and future model development.
thinking: 该论文采用前沿的法学与NLP交叉研究方法，构建了多维度法律查询分类法，并基于真实对话数据集进行分析，方法严谨且数据公开。其不足在于研究结论主要服务于AI模型开发与行为理解，对图书馆、信息机构等传统图情业务的直接落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究分析了用户在真实对话中向大语言模型寻求法律帮助的行为模式，发现超过七成涉及法律内容的对话旨在寻求个性化或实用性指导。

title: Reranking Answers of Large Language Models with Knowledge Graphs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25185v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Answering natural language questions over knowledge graph data is challenging due to the vast number of facts, which can be difficult to process and navigate. One potential solution for this issue is to use mined subgraphs related to the query, although this process still requires extracting these subgraphs. This research presents a solution for extracting subgraphs related to entity candidates from a question-and-answer set, which can be obtained by inferring a large language model by calculating the shortest paths between entities. The proposed approaches detail various features that can be extracted from the subgraphs and reranking models to select the most probable answers from a list of candidates. Experiments were conducted on Wikidata to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches. This involved enumerating all the main feature types that can be extracted from mined subgraphs and a detailed analysis of the proposed features and reranking method combinations. In addition, a public web application that provides a useful web tool for studying the graph space between question and answer entities has been developed to work with subgraphs. This includes visualization of the extracted subgraph and automatic generation of natural language text to describe it.
thinking: 该论文结合大语言模型与知识图谱进行答案重排序，技术方案前沿且方法严谨，在Wikidata上进行了系统实验并开发了可视化工具。但作为预印本，其业务落地价值尚不明确，需进一步验证在真实图书馆或信息机构场景中的适用性。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种利用知识图谱子图特征对大语言模型的候选答案进行重排序的方法，以提升知识问答的准确性。

title: SPARC: Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25265v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Speech anonymization has focused on the acoustic signal, leaving open how much speaker information the transcribed words themselves retain. In this work, we study pairwise speaker and demographic-attribute verification from transcribed speech. We introduce SPARC (Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus), a benchmark built from two podcast corpora comprising over 12,500 speakers, 1.5M quality-filtered utterances, and speaker-level inferred or source-provided labels for sex, age, and accent, and evaluate five attribution models and three LLMs on identity- and attribute-verification trials with episode- and metadata-based topic proxies. LLM adversaries distinguish same-speaker pairs from text alone. Attribute-label agreement is harder to verify, but LLMs perform sex- and accent-label verification above chance. Finally, releasing only short probe texts (50 words) degrades the strongest adversaries the most, offering a partial reduction in observed linkage.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于语音转录文本中的说话人身份与属性识别，引入大规模基准数据集SPARC并评估多种模型，在语音匿名化领域具有方法学创新性。然而，作为预印本，其研究深度和论证完整性有待同行评议进一步检验，且其直接应用于图书馆等图情机构的场景尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，仅从语音转录的文本中，大语言模型就能有效识别说话人身份，这对语音匿名化技术提出了新的挑战。

title: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26190v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.
thinking: 该论文构建了一个针对间接表达自杀、自残和痛苦的多标签分类数据集，并设计了基于专家校准的代理对齐评估方法，在心理健康支持场景的NLP评估方法上具有前沿性。然而，论文主要贡献在于数据集构建和评估框架，其技术方法（如自动化配置文件）虽具创新性，但直接应用于图书馆或信息机构的业务场景路径尚不明确，实践价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究创建了一个用于评估AI系统对间接心理痛苦表达回应能力的数据集和专家校准评估框架。

title: Self-Consistency of Entity Sets and Citations in a Deep Research System under Repeated Prompting
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26421v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于深度研究代理在重复提示下的输出一致性评估，采用了实体集和引文集的Jaccard相似度量化方法，技术方法较为前沿且具有创新性。然而，研究仅基于单一商业系统在单一主题（网络安全）下的十次运行，样本量有限，结论的普适性有待进一步验证，且其发现对图书馆等机构的具体业务实践指导价值尚不直接。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，深度研究代理在相同提示下生成的报告，其提及的实体和引文存在显著不一致性，且不一致程度与实体类别相关。

title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
abstract:
arXiv:2610.26830v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.
thinking: 论文探讨了混合架构中循环层与注意力机制的学习竞争现象，并提出了分阶段训练方法以提升模型性能。研究结合了前沿的神经网络架构分析，方法上通过层归因分析和实验验证，但尚未在图书馆或信息管理领域形成具体应用方案。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究发现混合架构中循环层与注意力机制存在学习竞争，提出分阶段训练方法可显著提升语言模型在检索相关任务上的表现。

title: UltraData-Code: From Raw Repositories to Algorithmically Dense and Task-Oriented Code Data
abstract:
arXiv:2610.23960v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Code generation has become a core capability of large language models (LLMs), and code data is central to the pre-training process that develops it. As obtaining public code of sufficient quality becomes more difficult, further progress cannot rely on corpus expansion alone. Tiered data management instead applies increasingly targeted processing to smaller data pools, producing data states suited to different training objectives. Following this perspective, we present UltraData-Code as four connected data states spanning repository archival at L0, standardized natural code at L1, algorithmic selection at L2, and task-oriented synthesis at L3. L0 preserves repository data and provenance for reprocessing, while L1 applies scalable filtering, normalization, and near-deduplication for broad pre-training. L2 selects high-quality algorithmically relevant files using language-adaptive relevance signals and quality constraints, yielding approximately 400B tokens of UltraData-Code-L2 across 11 programming languages for focused continual pre-training. L3 converts selected implementations into structured programming exercises, yielding approximately 150B tokens of UltraData-Code-L3 across the same 11 languages for task-oriented mid-training or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Under controlled 10B-token continual pre-training of a 1B model, L2 improves pass@1 over L1 by 7.80 percentage points (pp) on EvalPlus and 5.13pp on MultiPL-E. Replacing half of the L2 training tokens with L3 yields a further gain of 8.42pp and 8.07pp on the two benchmarks, respectively. Both gains increase when the training budget scales to 100B tokens. We have released our datasets and classifiers to support further research on LLMs.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种针对代码数据的层级处理框架（L0-L3），并进行了实验验证，在方法设计和实验验证上具有较高的严谨性。其核心贡献在于为LLM的代码能力训练提供了系统化的数据管理方案，具有明确的应用价值，但所涉及的技术（如代码过滤、去重、任务合成）虽属当前主流，并非突破性前沿。
one_sentence_summary: 论文提出了一个从原始代码仓库到任务导向型数据的四级处理框架，能有效提升大语言模型的代码生成能力。

title: Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24108v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $\rho=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.
thinking: 该论文系统比较了三种多模态对齐范式（联合、解耦、智能体）在多种任务和标签预算下的性能，并提出了基于诊断的范式选择方法，方法严谨且实验设计全面。然而，其技术核心仍基于现有预训练模型，前沿突破有限，且作为方法学比较研究，其直接指导具体业务系统选型的落地价值相对间接。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过大量实验发现，没有一种多模态AI模型构建范式能通吃所有任务，并提出了一个基于任务诊断的两步选择方法来指导范式选择。

title: Pluralistic Alignment in Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24471v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. Preference representation, implementation mechanism, modality, and evidence quality are treated as cross-cutting design choices rather than additional forms of pluralism. We synthesize a protocol-bounded corpus of 70 works on pluralistic alignment and neighboring areas, using the objective-by-human-reference matrix to map existing approaches and identify underexplored combinations. The coded literature concentrates on Steerable Pluralism and Distributional Pluralism, while eligible Overton Pluralism work appears only at the aggregate-population level under our stated protocol. We then connect each objective to the evidence needed to support it, including perspective validity, conditional fidelity, distributional fidelity, support preservation, and uncertainty in subgroup estimates. Together, the taxonomy and evaluation framework clarify what current methods establish, where their claims exceed their evidence, and how future systems can represent disagreement without mistaking variation for faithful representation.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个关于语言模型多元对齐的清晰分类框架，将现有研究归纳为三种目标类型和三种人类参考来源，并讨论了相应的评估证据需求。其理论贡献在于澄清了该领域的概念混淆，并为未来研究提供了系统化的评估路径，但作为一篇综述性理论框架论文，其技术前沿性主要体现在概念整合而非技术创新，且缺乏直接可部署的实践方案。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文为语言模型的多元对齐研究建立了一个分类与评估框架，旨在厘清不同研究目标并指导未来如何有效表征人类偏好分歧。

title: SoK: PIAtlas: Decomposing the Unbounded Prompt Injection Attack Space
abstract:
arXiv:2610.24999v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Prompt injection is the dominant security risk for large-language-model (LLM) applications and agents, yet the field still lacks a coherent map of how these attacks are constructed. More than twenty public datasets describe prompt injection using incompatible vocabularies, often organized around delivery vector, attacker goal, or generation method. In this Systematization of Knowledge, we present PIAtlas, a taxonomy organized instead around how the injected instruction is constructed to subvert the underlying model. Its six classes, one per subversion mechanism, form the roots of a hierarchy of techniques and sub-techniques that researchers can use to describe attacks consistently and design more systematic evaluations. We derive the taxonomy from how LLMs are trained, prompted, and influenced by human-like framing, and compare it with historical attack data. To ground this comparison, we release PICorpus, to our knowledge the largest license-clean collection of public prompt-injection datasets, and map thousands of its records to PIAtlas under a human-verified protocol. The mapping shows that attacks usually combine several techniques drawn from only a few mechanisms. It also reveals gaps that existing labels obscure: widely used agent benchmarks test only part of the attack space, and adaptive attackers favor mechanisms that curated benchmarks underrepresent. PIAtlas thus provides a common foundation for understanding this attack space, improving benchmark coverage, and guiding red teaming and defenses.
thinking: 该论文通过系统化知识方法构建了提示注入攻击的分类体系PIAtlas，并基于LLM的训练和提示机制推导分类，方法严谨且基于大规模验证数据集PICorpus。其贡献在于为LLM安全领域提供了统一的分析框架和评估基准，具有直接指导红队测试和防御设计的实践价值，但技术核心是分类学构建而非前沿算法创新。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个基于攻击机制的大语言模型提示注入攻击统一分类体系，并发现现有基准测试未能覆盖全部攻击空间。

title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25126v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于因果推断和随机对照实验的技能库全生命周期管理框架，方法设计严谨且具有创新性，但研究场景高度技术化，与图情领域的直接业务关联较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过在线随机对照实验来追踪和管理强化学习智能体中技能生命周期的新框架。

title: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25182v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于用户搜索交互和知识图谱自动生成对话推荐数据集的方法，结合了LLM代理和概率状态机，技术前沿性较强。方法设计系统且可控，生成的对话质量经评估优于现有基准，但作为数据集构建方法，其业务落地价值主要限于研究社区，对实际图书馆或信息机构的直接应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种无需人工标注、利用用户搜索行为和知识图谱来自动生成高质量对话推荐数据集的新方法。

title: Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25384v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.
thinking: 该论文针对知识图谱问答中的强化学习奖励分配问题，提出了基于结果锚定的信用再分配方法，在技术层面结合了当前前沿的大语言模型与知识图谱交互，方法设计具有创新性。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的全面检验，且其业务落地价值目前主要体现在提升特定任务的算法性能上，与图书馆、信息机构等具体业务场景的直接关联性较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的信用分配方法，能更有效地指导大语言模型在知识图谱问答任务中的多步推理过程。

title: Budgeted Attack Scheduling for LLM Red-Teaming: The Roles of Static Priors, Semantic Guidance, and Online Feedback
abstract:
arXiv:2610.25897v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: As jailbreak attacks against large language models (LLMs) become increasingly diverse, red-teaming has come to rely on large libraries of jailbreak prompts and attack strategies to evaluate the robustness of victim models and their defense settings. However, attack effectiveness is highly condition-dependent: an attack that succeeds under one victim-defense setting may fail under another, while exhaustively evaluating the full attack library for each setting incurs substantial token and monetary costs. This motivates studying how jailbreak attacks should be prioritized under a limited attempt budget for efficient robustness evaluation. In this work, we formalize this problem as budgeted attack scheduling over a fixed attack library and investigate three complementary signals under a fixed victim-defense condition: (1) static historical attack success rate (ASR) priors; (2) semantic guidance from LLMs; and (3) online feedback from earlier queries. Building on these signals, we design four scheduling strategies and evaluate them across three victim models and three defense settings on GPT-5.2. Extensive experiments clearly characterize the conditions under which each signal is most effective. Historical ASR provides a strong initialization, but its reliability degrades under defense-induced distribution shifts. Semantic guidance consistently improves or matches static prior-based scheduling in the cold-start regime, while online feedback becomes particularly valuable when transferred priors become stale. Semantic guidance and online feedback can also partially compensate for missing historical priors. Taken together, these findings characterize budgeted red-teaming as an attack scheduling problem in which historical priors, semantic guidance, and online feedback play complementary roles.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于大语言模型红队测试中的攻击调度优化问题，提出了结合静态先验、语义引导和在线反馈三种信号的调度策略，方法设计严谨，实验充分。其技术思路具有前沿性，但研究成果主要面向模型安全评估这一特定技术环节，在图情领域的直接业务落地价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过结合历史成功率、语义引导和在线反馈三种信号，优化了在有限尝试次数下对大语言模型进行红队测试的攻击调度策略。

title: Enriching Patent Claim Generation with European Patent Dataset
abstract:
arXiv:2505.12568v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Drafting patent claims is time-intensive, costly, and requires professional skill. Therefore, researchers have investigated large language models (LLMs) to assist inventors in writing claims. However, existing work has largely relied on datasets from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). To enlarge research scope regarding various jurisdictions, drafting conventions, and legal standards, we introduce EPD, a European patent dataset. EPD presents rich textual data and structured metadata to support multiple patent-related tasks, including claim generation. This dataset enriches the field in three critical aspects: (1) Jurisdictional diversity: Patents from different offices vary in legal and drafting conventions. EPD fills a critical gap by providing a benchmark of European patents to enable more comprehensive evaluation. (2) Quality improvement: EPD offers high-quality granted patents with finalized and legally approved texts, whereas others consist of patent applications that are unexamined or provisional. Experiments show that LLMs fine-tuned on EPD significantly outperform those trained on previous datasets and even GPT-4o in claim quality and cross-domain generalization. (3) Real-world simulation: We propose a difficult subset of EPD to better reflect real-world challenges. Results reveal that all tested LLMs perform substantially worse on challenging samples, which highlights the need for future research.
thinking: 该论文通过构建欧洲专利数据集（EPD）来丰富专利权利要求生成的训练数据，弥补了现有研究过度依赖美国专利数据的不足，体现了数据多样性的价值。研究采用LLM微调实验验证了EPD在提升生成质量和跨领域泛化能力上的优势，方法较为严谨，但作为数据集构建类研究，其前沿技术应用主要体现在数据资源的贡献上，而非方法论的突破。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个高质量的欧洲专利数据集，用于训练大语言模型，能显著提升自动生成专利权利要求的质量和实际应用能力。

title: The Super Emotion Dataset
abstract:
arXiv:2505.15348v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Despite the wide-scale usage and development of emotion classification datasets in NLP, the field lacks a standardized, large-scale resource that follows a psychologically grounded taxonomy. Existing datasets either use inconsistent emotion categories, suffer from limited sample size, or focus on specific domains. The SuperEmotion dataset addresses this gap by harmonizing diverse text sources into a unified framework based on Shaver's empirically validated emotion taxonomy, enabling more consistent cross-domain emotion recognition research. This report describes version 2 of the dataset. We also report baseline results for a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于构建一个基于心理学验证分类法的大规模标准化情感数据集，采用现代BERT模型进行基线实验，技术方法较为前沿。然而，作为数据集构建报告，其直接应用于图书馆等业务场景的路径尚不明确，且方法论部分主要描述数据整合过程，对样本代表性、偏差控制等严谨性细节的讨论有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个基于心理学分类的大规模标准化文本情感数据集，为跨领域情感分析研究提供了统一资源。

title: Reasoning for Hierarchical Text Classification: The Case of Patents
abstract:
arXiv:2510.07167v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Hierarchical text classification (HTC) assigns documents to multiple levels of a pre-defined taxonomy. Automated patent subject classification represents one of the hardest HTC scenarios because of professional difficulties and extensive labels. Prior approaches only output a flat label set, which offers little insight into the reason behind predictions. Therefore, we propose Reasoning for Hierarchical Classification (RHC), a novel framework that reformulates HTC as a step-by-step reasoning task to sequentially deduce hierarchical labels. RHC trains large language models (LLMs) in two stages: a cold-start stage that aligns outputs with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning format and a reinforcement learning (RL) stage to enhance multi-step reasoning ability. RHC demonstrates four advantages in our experiments. (1) Effectiveness: RHC surpasses previous baselines and outperforms the supervised fine-tuning counterparts by approximately 3% in accuracy and macro F1. (2) Explainability: RHC produces natural-language justifications before prediction to facilitate human inspection. (3) Scalability: RHC scales favorably with model size with larger gains compared to standard fine-tuning. (4) Applicability: Beyond patents, we further demonstrate that RHC achieves state-of-the-art performance on other widely used HTC benchmarks, which highlights its broad applicability.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的层次文本分类推理框架，在专利分类这一复杂场景中取得了优于基线方法的性能，并具备良好的可解释性。其方法结合了思维链对齐和强化学习，技术路径前沿且设计严谨，但作为预印本论文，其实际在图书馆或信息机构业务中的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种让大语言模型通过逐步推理来完成专利等复杂文档层次分类的新方法，效果优于传统方式且能提供解释。

title: PaperAudit-Bench: Benchmarking Error Detection in Research Papers for Critical Automated Peer Review
abstract:
arXiv:2601.19916v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent peer reviews but often miss sparse, subtle, and document-level scientific errors. We introduce PaperAudit-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating paper-level error detection and error-aware automated review. It comprises (1) PaperAudit-Dataset, 220 high-quality AI/ML papers containing more than 2,200 controlled synthetic errors across eight categories, and (2) PaperAudit-Review, an evidence-aware framework that links structured error detection to review generation. Experiments across models, error categories, paper sections, and analysis depths show that sparse long-context auditing remains challenging for current LLMs. Conditioning review generation on explicit, manuscript-grounded error evidence produces more conservative and discriminative assessments that align more closely with human judgments than representative automated-review baselines. The dataset also supports post-training compact detectors through SFT and RL; Qwen3-14B achieves 55.8% F1 at Detection@1 under a fixed held-out protocol. A PubPeer transfer study and deployment in ScienceOne, a scientific foundation-model platform led by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, further illustrate practical applicability.
  Code and Dataset Page: https://github.com/TU2021/PaperAudit
  ScienceOne Manuscript Review: https://www.scienceone.cn/lit/#/assistant
affiliations: Academy of Sciences, further illustrate practical applicability.
