title: General Classification for Digital Knowledge: Algorithm, Identifiers and a First Benchmark
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19547v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Digital libraries and knowledge graphs need a way to organize very large collections so that related works are close and any work is quick to reach. The classifications libraries inherited for this, such as LCC and DDC, are maintained by editorial staff, are partly closed, and were not built against a stated, measurable objective. We propose the opposite: a general classification that is fitted, under the constraints that make a classification usable on a shelf or in a browse list, to the same quantity that a companion survey and benchmark (Awad, 2026) ranks existing schemes by. The objective is J = D + 0.005 N, where D is the normalized Dasgupta cost of the class tree on a fixed similarity graph (Dasgupta, 2016) and N is an expected navigation cost in bits with a per-level charge. Two constraints are hard: every class is a contiguous run of one fixed shelf order (the optimal-alphabetic-tree constraint of Hu and Tucker, 1971), and new works are filed by splitting leaf classes only, so that every existing class keeps its code, label and parent. On a corpus of 10,000 arXiv papers the fitted prototype has 110 hand-labelled classes and reaches cost 0.1722 in sample (average linkage 0.1518; arXiv's own categories 0.3333; the best existing scheme reached through the same lexical classifier 0.6414, from the survey). Filing 500 library books as new works created 16 classes and changed no existing identifier. Fit, filing and scoring share one embedding: the held-out skill of 0.922 falls to 0.896 when the same fit is scored on the graphs of the two other models, and on books the average falls from 0.806 to 0.731. The scheme has also seen only arXiv, and labels for inserted classes are weak. We state those limits plainly, release the scheme as CC0 open data, and ask whether a learned, open, order-preserving classification can become a general one.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于算法和标识符的数字知识通用分类方法，并构建了首个基准测试，在方法严谨性上表现突出，通过具体数据集（arXiv论文）验证了方案的有效性。然而，该研究主要基于arXiv单一数据集，对新插入类别的标签处理较弱，且其前沿性更多体现在对传统分类问题的优化方法上，而非引入全新的颠覆性技术。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种基于算法优化和固定顺序约束的自动分类方案，在arXiv论文数据集上构建了原型并验证了其优于传统分类法的性能。

title: Reading the Neighborhood: Text-Attentive Graph Reranking for Automated Subject Indexing
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20048v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Subject indexing assigns descriptors from a controlled vocabulary to bibliographic records, a task characterized by thousands of labels, few positive examples per label, and a long tail of rarely used descriptors. Existing extreme multi-label classifiers treat the vocabulary as a flat list, ignoring the semantic relations that thesauri encode. We present TAGHN, a heterogeneous graph reranker over a per-document subgraph of retrieved candidates augmented with the thesaurus neighborhood. The relevance of a candidate descriptor is estimated jointly from its similarity with the document and also the degree to which the candidate's thesaurus neighborhood matches the document content. A decomposed scoring head combines interpretable graph-derived features with retrieval signals. On STW, an economic thesaurus of 6,198 descriptors, TAGHN reaches 0.380 macro F1 against 0.346 for a fine-tuned cross-encoder and 0.278 for a fixed-vocabulary XMLC classifier. In terms of micro F1, it outperforms reranking models and stays competitive (-3.0) with the best fixed-vocabulary XMLC model. Qualitative analysis shows the graph resolving errors that per-label scoring cannot, selecting a narrower gold descriptor where an unstructured reranker settles for its broader parent.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种结合知识图谱语义关系的主题标引方法，在传统分类器基础上引入图重排序机制，有效利用了叙词表的结构信息，在长尾标签处理上表现突出。其方法设计严谨，在标准数据集上进行了量化对比与定性分析，但作为预印本论文，其实际在图书馆业务系统中的部署效果尚待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过引入叙词表语义关系的图重排序模型，提升了自动化主题标引在长尾、细粒度标签上的准确性。

title: Filling holes in science draws collective attention, but most higher-order holes remain unexplored
abstract:
arXiv:2608.28822v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Most scientific discoveries justify their significance by filling holes between existing ideas and arguments. Representing knowledge as high-dimensional concept embeddings, we use persistent homology to detect scientific holes of increasing order, from lower-order gaps between disconnected ideas to higher-order cavities within unevenly connected ones; then we identify the research that fills them. Researchers who close holes draw outsized collective attention, staging novelty that the citing literature rewards, most strongly in discovery-oriented fields and least in design-oriented fields. Closing a hole is followed by persistent work on the same combinations of concepts at many times the rate of comparable holes left open. Yet as knowledge grows, higher-order holes explode while the fraction of research that fills them collapses, leaving most higher-order combinations unexplored. These results call for a richer science of holes and mark a frontier where contemporary AI might help fill the gaps human science opens.
thinking: 该论文采用持续同调等前沿数学方法分析科学知识结构中的“空洞”，方法新颖且具有理论深度，但缺乏具体应用场景和实证验证，实践指导性较弱。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现填补科学知识结构中的“空洞”能获得更多关注，但更高阶的“空洞”数量激增且大多未被探索。

title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19065v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has emerged as a strong candidate generator for sequential recommendation as language models and semantic-item identifiers have improved. However, GR is not a uniformly stronger replacement of dense retrieval (DR) in online retail candidate generation. We examine their differences on two Amazon Toys datasets under different metrics. GR leads on best relevant item value among users both methods cover, while DR leads on exact-target recall and relevant value across the ranked list. With deep analysis, we find that popularity contributes the most to GR's measured value lead. Adding the same static item value to DR in one reranking step reverses this lead and keeps recall above GR. Finally, on an industrial-scale internal e-commerce dataset with LLM-judged relevance, we show that a 14B SID-LLM still underperforms a $47\times$ smaller dense encoder.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于生成式检索与稠密检索在电商推荐场景下的性能对比，采用多数据集、多指标进行实证分析，并深入探讨了流行度偏差对结果的影响，方法较为严谨。然而，研究主要基于现有模型（如SID-LLM和稠密编码器）的对比实验，技术前沿性主要体现在应用场景的深入剖析而非方法创新；其发现对优化工业级推荐系统有直接指导意义，但结论（如静态价值先验的重要性）的普适性有待在其他领域进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在电商推荐中，生成式检索的优势主要源于流行度偏差，而通过为稠密检索引入静态项目价值进行重排序，即可逆转性能差距并保持更高的召回率。

title: RCER: Reconstructing Cross-Evidence Relations for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19398v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Iterative retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) accumulates knowledge from retrieved evidence to answer complex questions, but existing methods struggle to reconstruct entity correspondences and inferential dependencies across retrieved passages as new information emerges. We propose RCER, an iterative RAG method that reconstructs these cross-evidence relations directly from accumulated source passages. Inter-round relational evidence acquisition identifies entity correspondences and relational dependencies to drive dynamic problem decomposition and iterative retrieval. Reasoning context reconstruction independently constructs a coherent reasoning context through joint selection of complementary passages and derivation of cross-evidence inferences. Cross-evidence compositional reasoning leverages these inferences to establish entity correspondences and compose relations across selected passages for answer derivation. Experiments show that RCER outperforms the best baselines by 2.83 EM and 3.06 F1 points on average across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and achieves superior performance on narrative and implicit reasoning tasks.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种迭代检索增强生成方法RCER，通过重建跨证据关系来提升复杂问答性能，在方法设计上具有创新性，并经过多基准测试验证。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法严谨性虽在实验部分有所体现，但尚未经过同行评议的全面检验，且其技术前沿性主要体现在对现有RAG框架的优化上，而非引入全新的基础技术。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种通过重建跨证据关系来提升迭代检索增强生成模型在复杂问答任务中性能的新方法。

title: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.
thinking: 论文针对冷启动推荐中的拓扑隔离问题，提出了一种创新的双分支图知识蒸馏框架，在方法设计上具有前沿性，并通过多数据集实验验证了有效性。然而，作为一篇arXiv预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的完整检验，且其技术方案对实际图书馆或信息系统的工程落地能力提出了较高要求。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种新的双分支图学习框架，通过知识蒸馏有效缓解了推荐系统中新物品因缺乏交互数据而导致的性能下降问题。

title: Twenty Days Later: A Pre-Registered Test of History-Based Forecasts of Brand Mentions in Gemini Answers
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19608v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Counts of which brands a large language model names are useful only if they hold long enough to act on. We test this with a pre-registered replication. The same 162 requests (54 questions in English, Estonian and Finnish about three software categories, four of twelve candidate brands per question, three repeats) were sent to gemini-3.1-pro-preview in three waves within about ten hours on 22 and 23 September 2026, and again on 13 October 2026, 20.3 days after the third wave, with identical request bodies. The plan and its decision rule were frozen, hashed and registered on OSF before the first call. The outcome is a lexical mention label per answer and brand, 648 per wave. The primary forecast, each brand-and-question cell's mention rate over the nine earlier answers, scored Brier 0.0281 and log loss 0.126, against Brier 0.0259 for the six-answer forecast of the 8-hour wave and a registered ceiling of 0.0559. It beat brand history (0.104), the overall rate (0.234) and a constant 0.5 (0.250) on both scores and in all nine question families (exact sign-flip p = 0.0039), so durability holds under the registered rule. A forecast frozen from the first wave alone scored 0.0599, 0.0587 and 0.0604 at horizons of 1.5 hours, 9.6 hours and 20.7 days. Of the 202 cells unanimous in the 8-hour wave, 194 were unchanged at D1 and none reversed. The latest wave alone was nearly as accurate as the pooled history (Brier 0.0292; pooled lower in 5 of 9 families, p = 0.28). Every answer reported the requested model version, and none issued a search query although search was enabled. A blind human check of 96 labels agreed with the rule on 94; both disagreements were adjudicated as rater omissions, so after adjudication the rule matched on 96 of 96. The test covers one model, one interval and twelve known brands, and estimates no decay rate.
thinking: 该论文采用预注册实验设计，方法严谨性突出，通过多轮重复测试验证了LLM品牌提及预测的稳定性。研究聚焦于特定模型和时间窗口，业务落地价值有限，但为信息检索系统的可预测性评估提供了方法论参考。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，基于大语言模型历史回答的品牌提及率预测，在20天内保持稳定，为评估AI输出一致性提供了实证依据。

title: XViewRank: Overlap-Conditioned Score Fusion for LLM-Augmented Sparse Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20122v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models can reduce vocabulary mismatch in sparse retrieval by generating alternative views of a query. Once these views are searched independently, however, their ranked lists may be complementary, redundant, or affected by query drift, making fixed fusion suboptimal. We present XViewRank, a lightweight retrieval-side method for conditionally fusing BM25 results from an original query, a hypothesis view, and a step-back view. For each pooled candidate, XViewRank retains three normalized BM25 scores and three query-level overlaps between the retrieved result sets. A small nonlinear scorer uses the overlaps as context that changes how the view-specific scores are interpreted, without jointly encoding query and passage text. Under a matched-input protocol, XViewRank improves nDCG@10 and MAP numerically over reciprocal rank fusion on both TREC DL 2019 and 2020, with a statistically significant MAP gain on DL19. Additional analyses show that the clearest benefit occurs when the view rankings have low agreement, while the evidence on DL20 is weaker. The results support overlap-conditioned score fusion as a compact retrieval-side alternative to fixed fusion, while also delimiting where its advantage is empirically established.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于重叠度条件化融合的轻量级检索方法，针对LLM生成多查询视图后的结果融合问题，方法设计巧妙且实验设计规范。但研究主要基于传统BM25检索，前沿技术应用有限，且实际落地场景和系统集成细节有待进一步明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种利用查询视图间重叠度动态融合检索结果的轻量级方法，在特定数据集上优于固定融合策略。

title: Creating SquashFS Images to Support HPC and AI Datasets
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: HPC users often download datasets on HPC systems for analysis and processing. When these datasets are comprised of hundreds of thousands (or more) of small files, accessing them in parallel can put a tremendous burden on the metadata servers of central parallel file systems. If the dataset is read-only, an effective solution is to compress the dataset into a SquashFS image. There are, however, a number of workflows that can be used to create such a dataset image, and we observed that some were more efficient than others. To provide more effective guidance for our userbase, we benchmarked eleven different workflows for creating SquashFS dataset image files of datasets with thousands to millions of very small files. We took into account whether the data arrived as tar.gz, zip, or files-and-directories downloads, whether the image creation was on the central file system or local compute node storage, and the number of SquashFS file compression threads used. This paper shares the results of these benchmarks and provides recommendations to HPC system users toward the best workflows to use for SquashFS image creation.
thinking: 该论文针对高性能计算环境中大规模小文件数据集并行访问的元数据瓶颈问题，提出了使用SquashFS镜像的解决方案，并通过系统性的基准测试比较了11种工作流程，方法严谨且结果具有直接指导意义。然而，其技术核心在于文件系统优化与工作流效率对比，虽涉及AI/HPC场景，但未采用前沿的AI模型或算法，技术前沿性一般。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过基准测试，为高性能计算用户提供了创建SquashFS数据集镜像以优化小文件访问性能的最佳实践指南。

title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19068v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. Evaluating on ToolBench (46,984 unique API endpoints, 50 categories) across single-tool (G1), intra-category multi-tool (G2), and cross-category multi-tool (G3) query subsets, we find a clear complexity-dependent crossover: RtP outperforms PtR on single-tool queries while PtR outperforms RtP on multi-tool queries. This crossover holds at every retrieval budget (k=1 to 20), is robust across registry sizes from 1k to 47k APIs, and is consistent across model families (Gemini 2.5 Flash and gpt-oss-120b). We characterize a stub-hallucination failure mode (the LLM invents plausible but non-existent API names) that acts as a double-edged sword: on simple queries PtR's stubs abstract away proper-noun signals that RtP matches directly, yet on complex queries the same mechanism decomposes multi-faceted intent into functional sub-needs. We further analyze token overhead and show that PtR's extra discovery call roughly doubles inference cost, which pays off on multi-tool queries but hurts on single-tool ones, motivating complexity-adaptive routing as a practical direction, one that can be driven by a zero-cost signal already present in the pipeline (RtP's top-1 retrieval score).
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型工具调用中的检索与规划顺序问题进行了系统性实验，提出了Plan-then-Retrieve新范式，并在大规模数据集上验证了其与任务复杂度的相关性，方法严谨且结论清晰。其研究场景虽聚焦于通用AI代理架构，但所探讨的工具发现、意图分解等核心问题对构建面向专业领域的智能检索与问答系统（如图书馆参考咨询、知识库问答）具有直接的启发和迁移价值，前沿性突出。不足在于其作为预印本，尚未经过同行评议的最终检验，且对图情领域具体业务场景的直接结合度有待深化。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在AI工具调用中，对于复杂任务先规划后检索优于先检索后规划，而简单任务则相反，这为设计自适应智能系统提供了关键依据。

title: AdCoEvo: A Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Advertising Delivery System
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19454v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Digital advertising is an important means for platforms to reach potential users and drive business growth. Advertising delivery is the core link between marketing objectives and actual returns. Existing methods have achieved partial automation in individual tasks such as bidding and budget allocation, but they still rely on human operators for overall coordination, making it difficult to support large-scale operations. They also often fail to achieve optimal performance, and individual experience remains difficult to turn into reusable operational capabilities. In addition, as advertising markets change, advertising delivery systems need timely strategy updates to remain effective in dynamic markets. To automate the entire advertising operations process and improve adaptability to market changes, we propose AdCoEvo, a co-evolving multi-agent advertising delivery system. Specifically, the system connects delivery decisions across different timescales and operational granularities through role specialization. Diagnostic results guide account planning and strategy adjustment in the next period. The multi-agent system updates its model parameters based on actual delivery outcomes and continually improves delivery strategies through mutual feedback among planning, adjustment, and diagnosis, thereby achieving co-evolution. Experiments show that, relative to the rule-based operational baseline (Rule), AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 14.02% while reducing cost per acquisition by 7.07%. Compared with a multi-agent system with fixed parameters, AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 3.96% and reduces cost per acquisition by 1.24%, indicating that co-evolution can yield greater delivery returns.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于协同进化多智能体的广告投放系统，属于信息检索领域的前沿应用探索，技术新颖性较高。其研究通过实验验证了系统在提升广告主价值和降低获客成本方面的有效性，具有明确的业务落地潜力，但实验细节和普适性验证方面略显不足。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种协同进化的多智能体广告投放系统，能自动优化投放策略，在实验中有效提升了广告主价值并降低了成本。

title: Retrieve What Helps, Only When It Helps: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Machine Translation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19528v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Retrieving external knowledge can improve large language model (LLM) translation by providing supplementary information such as idiom interpretations and terminology. However, existing retrieval-augmented machine translation systems typically apply predefined retrieval strategies uniformly across all inputs. We argue that translation operates in a partial-evidence regime: LLM's parametric knowledge suffices for many inputs, while external evidence benefits a subset and usually supports rather than directly provides the desired translation. This creates two challenges: deciding when to retrieve and what evidence to acquire. We introduce Selective Retrieval-Augmented Translation (SRAT), an agentic reinforcement learning framework that learns when to translate directly or retrieve, what to retrieve, and how to integrate these decisions by optimizing final translation quality. To align evidence retrieval with downstream translation quality rather than simple semantic similarity, we further develop joint Plackett--Luce optimization and translation-quality contrastive training for retriever-training. Experiments on idiom, knowledge-intensive, and document-level translation with offline or online retrieval show that SRAT consistently outperforms never- and always-retrieve baselines, and quality-aligned retriever training provides further gains when similarity-based retrieval is insufficient. The results demonstrate the benefit of treating retrieval as a learnable translation action rather than fixed preprocessing.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习的智能检索增强机器翻译框架，通过优化最终翻译质量来动态决策检索时机与内容，方法设计具有创新性且实验验证较为充分。然而，作为一篇预印本论文，其方法在真实图书馆或信息机构业务场景中的直接落地路径尚不明确，实践应用价值有待进一步探索。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种智能检索增强翻译框架，让大语言模型学会在必要时才检索外部知识，从而提升翻译质量。

title: HEM-Med: A Hierarchical Agentic Memory Framework for Safe Multi-Center Medication Recommendation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20191v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Medication recommendation (MR) is critical for clinical decision support. While existing MR methods are mostly designed for single-center learning, where only one independent hospital is involved, multi-center MR with hospitals of different scales has become increasingly demanding in practice. In multi center settings, abundant data from large medical centers can improve recommendation performance for low-resource centers. Despite a few preliminary attempts on this task, two critical gaps remain. Gap 1: Existing multi-center methods fail to disentangle transferable cross-hospital clinical experience from hospital-specific prescribing patterns, limiting clinical feasibility and physician acceptance. Gap 2: They commonly overlook multi label safety constraints of MR, including drug-drug interaction risks and local formulary feasibility, which are essential for safe real-world deployment. To address these gaps, we propose HEM-Med, a novel hierarchical agentic memory framework for multi-center MR. To address Gap 1, we design a disentangled hierarchical memory module that builds patient-level medication context attribution records and disentangles them into cross hospital experience memory and hospital-specific residual memory. To address Gap 2, we introduce a safety-aware medication set generation module, which integrates dual-level experience retrieval with safety-aware set decoding to produce clinically relevant, safer, and locally adaptive medication recommendations. Experiments on a real-world multi-center eICU dataset show that HEM-Med outperforms representative transfer learning, LLM-based, and MR baselines in terms of both recommendation accuracy and safety.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于分层智能体记忆的用药推荐框架，针对多中心场景下的关键挑战（经验解耦与安全约束）设计了创新方法，并进行了实证验证，技术前沿性和方法严谨性突出。然而，作为一项技术方案研究，其直接落地于图书馆或信息机构的路径尚不明确，实践应用价值更多体现在医疗信息学领域。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个分层记忆框架，用于在多医院场景下实现更安全、更准确的用药推荐。

title: CASI: Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20293v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate multiple retrieval actions jointly, while downstream systems often provide only one reward for the resulting set. Broadcasting this reward provides a valid score-function gradient estimator for the expected set-level objective, but does not determine a coalition-dependent within-set attribution. We introduce CASI (Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval), which constructs the missing counterfactual information through snapshot-grounded set intervention: generate and retrieve once, hold replayable snapshot components fixed, and evaluate alternative subsets under common conditions. Shapley aggregation converts these marginals into within-set credit, which bounded zero-sum advantage shaping incorporates into policy optimization. For m >= 4, singleton, leave-one-out, and full-set endpoints do not generally determine the Shapley allocation; under additive set values, extra coalition evaluations are redundant. In a five-action sponsored-search setting, exhaustive auction replay over 1,200 requests reveals substantial coalition dependence. Under the training-time evaluator, CASI achieves the highest median cosine similarity to a replay-defined Shapley reference among evaluated credit rules; under a sensitivity backend, CASI does not outperform Singleton. Across five independent training runs, CASI-trained policies achieve higher held-out auction-replay set value than Singleton- or Broadcast-trained policies. In a randomized seven-day production A/B test on 10% of traffic, the CASI-trained policy yields an observed 3.51% lift in the primary advertiser-value metric over production control.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于集合干预的信用分配方法（CASI），用于解决多检索动作联合生成时的奖励分配问题，方法设计具有创新性，并进行了生产环境A/B测试验证效果。但研究场景聚焦于赞助搜索广告，在图情领域的直接应用场景有限，且方法依赖于特定假设（如可重放快照），在通用信息检索环境中的适用性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种新的信用分配方法，能更公平地评估大语言模型联合执行多个检索动作时各自的贡献，并在广告搜索场景中提升了核心指标。

title: On the Impact of Graph Neural Networks in Recommender Systems: A Topological Perspective
abstract:
arXiv:2512.07384v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: In recommender systems, user-item interactions can be modeled as a bipartite graph, where user and item nodes are connected by undirected edges. This graph-based view has motivated the rapid adoption of graph neural networks (GNNs), which often outperform collaborative filtering (CF) methods such as latent factor models, deep neural networks, and generative strategies. Yet, despite their empirical success, the reasons why GNNs offer systematic advantages over other CF approaches remain only partially understood. This monograph advances a topology-centered perspective on GNN-based recommendation. We argue that a comprehensive understanding of these models' performance should consider the structural properties of user-item graphs and their interaction with GNN architectural design. To support this view, we introduce a formal taxonomy that distills common modeling patterns across eleven representative GNN-based recommendation approaches and consolidates them into a unified conceptual pipeline. We further formalize thirteen classical and topological characteristics of recommendation datasets and reinterpret them through the lens of graph machine learning. Using these definitions, we analyze the considered GNN-based recommender architectures to assess how and to what extent they encode such properties. Building on this analysis, we derive an explanatory framework that links measurable dataset characteristics to model behavior and performance. Taken together, this monograph re-frames GNN-based recommendation through its topological underpinnings and outlines open theoretical, data-centric, and evaluation challenges for the next generation of topology-aware recommender systems.
thinking: 该论文从拓扑学视角系统分析了图神经网络在推荐系统中的影响，构建了统一的概念框架和解释性模型，理论贡献突出。然而，作为一篇综述性专著，其前沿性主要体现在理论整合而非技术创新，且缺乏实证验证环节，方法严谨性因此受限。
one_sentence_summary: 该论文从拓扑结构角度解释了图神经网络推荐模型性能优异的原因，并构建了一个连接数据集特征与模型行为的理论解释框架。

title: Relevance Supervision Can Teach Neural Retrievers to Prefer LLM-Generated Text
abstract:
arXiv:2604.06163v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recent studies show that neural retrievers often exhibit source bias, ranking LLM-generated passages above semantically similar human-written ones, which threatens the reliability of modern information access systems. While this bias is often viewed as a model-level property, we show that relevance supervision itself can induce it. Empirically, source bias is clearest in relevance-supervised retrievers, and the same encoders become more LLM-preferring after relevance fine-tuning. We trace this effect to surface-level artifacts in supervised retrieval data: annotated positives and negatives differ systematically in properties such as fluency and lexical specificity, and these differences parallel those between LLM-generated and human-written passages. As a result, retrievers can learn artifact-based shortcuts for relevance. We further show theoretically that, under contrastive learning, artifacts that reliably separate positives from negatives can be encoded into learned relevance scores. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose complementary strategies that reduce source bias during training and at inference: balancing artifact distributions in negative sampling and removing the artifact-aligned embedding component, respectively. Overall, our findings support a data-centric view of source bias: retrievers may prefer LLM-generated text not merely because of inherent model properties, but because relevance supervision teaches them to rely on surface-level artifacts.
thinking: 该论文揭示了相关性监督数据中存在的表面特征差异是导致神经检索器偏好LLM生成文本的关键原因，这一发现对理解检索模型的偏差来源具有重要理论价值。论文通过实证分析和理论推导，提出了在训练和推理阶段减轻偏差的策略，方法较为严谨，但提出的解决方案在真实业务场景中的落地效果尚需进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，神经检索模型偏好AI生成文本的偏差，主要源于训练数据中正负样本的表面特征差异，而非模型本身固有属性。

title: UniRec: Bridging the Expressive Gap between Generative and Discriminative Recommendation via Chain-of-Attribute
abstract:
arXiv:2604.12234v5 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) reframes retrieval and ranking as autoregressive decoding over Semantic IDs (SIDs), unifying the multi-stage pipeline into a single model. Yet a fundamental expressive gap persists: discriminative models score items with direct feature access enabling explicit user-item crossing, whereas GR decodes over compact SID tokens without item-side signal. We formalize this via Bayes' theorem: ranking by p(y|f,u) is equivalent to ranking by p(f|y,u), which factorizes autoregressively over item features, showing that a generative model with full feature access matches its discriminative counterpart, with any practical gap stemming solely from incomplete feature coverage. We propose UniRec with Chain-of-Attribute (CoA) as its core mechanism. CoA prefixes each SID sequence with structured attribute tokens:category, seller, brand, before decoding the SID, recovering the item-side feature crossing that discriminative models exploit. Since items sharing identical attributes cluster in adjacent SID regions, attribute conditioning yields a measurable per-step entropy reduction H(s_k|s< H(s_k|s<k), narrowing the search space and stabilizing beam search. We further address two deployment challenges: Capacity-constrained SID introduces exposure-weighted capacity penalties into residual quantization to suppress token collapse and the Matthew effect; Conditional Decoding Context (CDC) combines Task-Conditioned BOS with hash-based Content Summaries to inject scenario signals at each decoding step. A joint RFT and DPO framework aligns the model with business objectives beyond distribution matching. Experiments show UniRec outperforms the strongest baseline by +22.6% HR@50 overall and +15.5% on high-value orders. Deployed on Shopee's e-commerce platform, online A/B tests confirm significant gains in PVCTR (+5.37%), orders (+4.76%), and GMV (+5.60%).
thinking: 论文针对生成式推荐模型在表达力上的固有缺陷，提出了创新的链式属性机制来融合项目特征，理论推导严谨，并通过大规模线上A/B测试验证了显著的业务提升，方法具有前沿性和高落地价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过引入链式属性机制，有效弥补了生成式推荐模型在利用项目特征方面的不足，显著提升了电商平台的推荐效果和商业指标。

title: Document-as-Image Representations Fall Short for Scientific Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2604.18508v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Many recent document embedding models are trained on document-as-image representations, embedding rendered pages as images rather than the underlying source. Meanwhile, existing benchmarks for scientific document retrieval, such as ArXivQA and ViDoRe, treat documents as images of pages, implicitly favoring such representations. In this work, we argue that this paradigm is not well-suited for text-rich multimodal scientific documents, where critical evidence is distributed across structured sources, including text, tables, and figures. To study this setting, we introduce ArXivDoc, a new benchmark constructed from the underlying LaTeX sources of scientific papers. Unlike PDF or image-based representations, LaTeX provides direct access to structured elements (e.g., sections, tables, figures, equations), enabling controlled query construction grounded in specific evidence types. We systematically compare text-only, image-based, and multimodal representations across both single-vector and multi-vector retrieval models. Our results show that: (1) document-as-image representations are consistently suboptimal, especially as document length increases; (2) text-based representations are most effective, even for figure-based queries, by leveraging captions and surrounding context; and (3) interleaved text+image representations outperform document-as-image approaches without requiring specialized training.
thinking: 该论文针对当前科学文档检索领域广泛采用的文档图像化表示范式提出了有力质疑，并通过构建基于LaTeX源文件的新基准ArXivDoc，系统验证了文本表示在检索中的核心优势。其研究方法严谨，实验设计清晰，但研究结论主要适用于结构化的科学文档，在更广泛的非结构化或纯图像文档场景下的普适性有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，对于科学文档检索，直接利用文本内容比将文档当作图像处理效果更好，即使查询涉及图表。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation to Support Railways Engineering Tasks: A Case Study
abstract:
arXiv:2607.01244v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: The growing number and complexity of technical regulations represent an important challenge for all professionals in regulated industries. This paper describes a case study, from design to deployment, of building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for the consultation of complex technical regulations in the railway domain. Although developed for the railway sector, this testimony of an industrial experience is of particular value for technical domains where regulatory compliance and accurate information retrieval from complex documentation are essential requirements. It also constitutes a human-centered approach for implementing LLM-powered technical documentation consultation across various regulated industries, balancing technological capabilities with domain expertise.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于检索增强生成（RAG）系统在铁路工程法规咨询中的实际构建与部署案例，采用了当前前沿的大语言模型应用范式，技术前沿性突出。其研究基于真实工业场景，详细描述了从设计到落地的全过程，对同类受监管行业具有直接的参考和移植价值，但作为单一案例研究，其方法论的普适性和严谨性验证稍显不足。
one_sentence_summary: 本文通过一个铁路工程案例，展示了如何构建一个基于检索增强生成技术的人本化系统，用于准确查询复杂的行业技术法规。

title: The Dice Roll Method: A Standardized Protocol for Repeated-Query Auditing of Large Language Model Brand Recommendations
abstract:
arXiv:2609.04047v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Background: Researchers increasingly use repeated identical prompts to audit stochastic variation in large language model (LLM) brand recommendations, yet no standardized protocol exists for setting iteration counts, selecting stability metrics, or establishing reliability thresholds. Objective: We formalize the Dice Roll Method as a reusable protocol for repeated-query auditing of LLM brand recommendations, grounded in a generative model of temperature-scaled nucleus sampling. Methods: Total response variance is decomposed into sampling, prompt-phrasing, run-to-run, and model-version components. The stack: a negative-binomial mixed model with iterations as repeated measures; Cliff's delta as the distribution-free effect size; dependence-preserving bootstrap; simulation-based power; a generalizability-theory decomposition; drift diagnostics on pinned snapshots. We reanalyse five brand-recommendation auditing studies: approximately 190,000 observations, 270+ brands, 6 languages, iteration counts 5 to 40. Results: The recomputed D-study supports no fixed tiers. Across 250 distinct questions (S5), G is 0.96 at five runs and 1 to 2 runs reach 0.80, also within each model. For five versions of one question (S1 Valentine's subset, Gemini) it is 0.27 (95% CI 0.00 to 0.52), which fixes no run count. Runs follow from a pilot: n = 4 x residual / cell variance. Simulated single-cell power for a large Cliff's delta is 0.15 to 0.19 at five runs and 0.8 at 15 to 25. The four metric families (count, set, embedding, PASOR) are complementary. A pre-registered external validation on three independent corpora reproduces the D-study prediction in 37 of 39 cells with no failures; fixed tiers do not transfer. Conclusion: The protocol gives repeated-query auditing of LLM brand recommendations a statistically principled footing under the conditional, non-Gaussian structure of real autoregressive generation.
thinking: 该论文针对大语言模型品牌推荐审计中重复查询缺乏标准化方法的问题，提出了一个基于生成模型的统计协议，方法体系严谨，分解了方差来源并整合了多种统计技术。其研究具有明确的方法论创新和工具价值，但作为一项方法学论文，其直接业务落地场景相对特定，主要服务于相关领域的研究者。
one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一种名为“掷骰子法”的标准化统计协议，用于严谨地评估大语言模型在品牌推荐任务中因随机性产生的回答波动。

title: When RAG Doesn't Help: LLMs for Plausible Material Prediction of Vehicle Components
abstract:
arXiv:2609.18437v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: In this work, we explore whether LLMs can predict and explain plausible materials for vehicle components such as brake discs or fuel injectors without extensive fine-tuning. We compare a standard generative LLM baseline, single-pass Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and an iterative Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) variant across two LLMs, using a domain-filtered Wikipedia corpus that proved helpful in prior work. As no gold standard exists, we develop and release a reusable web-based annotation tool supporting crucial functions for structured domain-expert judgments, such as highlighting, ratings and ranking. Expert agreement is reasonable for plausibility, lower for ratings. LLM-based generation compares favorably to prior work. RAG and CoVe do not improve on it and are partly rated worse by experts. Contrary to prior work, Wikipedia-based retrieval does not help in our setup.
thinking: 该论文探讨了LLM在车辆部件材料预测中的应用，并比较了不同生成方法的效果，具有一定的技术前沿性。研究设计了基于Web的专家标注工具，方法较为严谨，但专家评分一致性较低，且RAG方法未带来预期提升，实践应用价值有限。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在车辆部件材料预测任务中，基于维基百科检索增强的生成方法并未比标准大语言模型基线表现更好。

title: Ground-Truth Subgraphs for Better Training and Evaluation of Knowledge Graph Augmented LLMs
abstract:
arXiv:2511.04473v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Retrieval of information from graph-structured knowledge bases represents a promising direction for improving the factuality of LLMs. While various solutions have been proposed, a comparison of methods is difficult due to the lack of challenging QA datasets with ground-truth targets for graph retrieval. We present SynthKGQA, an LLM-powered framework for generating high-quality Knowledge Graph Question Answering datasets from any Knowledge Graph, providing the full set of ground-truth facts in the KG to reason over questions. To demonstrate its utility, we apply SynthKGQA to ogbl-wikikg2, a Wikidata-derived KG, and validate generated items against an up-to-date dump of Wikidata to create GTSQA. This new dataset is specifically designed to test zero-shot generalization with respect to unseen graph structures and relation types, enabling us to analyze the abilities and limitations of SOTA graph retrieval approaches at an unprecedented level of granularity. We also show that KG retrievers trained on GTSQA can transfer to a human-curated benchmark, and that the ground-truth subgraphs produced by SynthKGQA provide a better training supervision signal than previously-used heuristics.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的知识图谱问答数据集生成框架，并构建了专门用于评估图检索方法泛化能力的数据集，技术方法具有前沿性。该框架能生成高质量的训练数据，对提升知识图谱增强型大语言模型的性能有直接帮助，实践价值较高。研究方法通过在新数据集和人工标注基准上的迁移效果进行验证，论证过程较为严谨。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个利用大语言模型自动生成高质量知识图谱问答数据集的框架，以更好地训练和评估知识图谱检索方法。

title: GenState-AI: State-Aware Dataset for Text-to-Video Retrieval on AI-Generated Videos
abstract:
arXiv:2603.14426v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Existing text-to-video retrieval benchmarks often permit matching from static appearance, making it difficult to determine whether models capture state changes and final outcomes. We introduce GenState-AI, a benchmark comprising 956 AI-generated videos and 195 verified state-change queries across Toy, Cartoon, Home, and Manipulation domains. Its construction uses prompt-controlled variants that target either conflicting temporal/state outcomes or semantic substitutions. Following human verification, all valid videos contribute to subset-level retrieval pools, while complete query-specific triplets support diagnostic hard-negative ordering. We evaluate VCF-Lik, Qwen3-VL, and LanguageBind using both standard Recall@K and triplet-based consistency metrics. Qwen3-VL (8B) achieves the best macro-average R@1 and triplet consistency, while LanguageBind obtains the highest semantic discrimination accuracy. However, stronger retrieval does not consistently yield correct hard-negative ordering, and Qwen3-VL and LanguageBind remain weak on Manipulation triplets, where VCF-Lik performs substantially better. GenState-AI therefore provides a controlled diagnostic testbed for distinguishing global retrieval quality from fine-grained temporal and semantic grounding in AI-generated videos.
thinking: 论文构建了GenState-AI数据集，专门用于评估AI生成视频的文本-视频检索模型对状态变化的捕捉能力，在方法上采用了可控提示生成和人工验证，确保了数据集的构建严谨性。其核心价值在于提供了一个诊断性的评测基准，有助于推动检索模型在细粒度语义和时序理解上的进步，但作为基准研究，其直接业务落地价值相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个专门用于评测AI生成视频检索模型能否理解视频中状态变化的诊断性数据集。

title: When More Documents Hurt RAG: Measuring and Reducing Vector Search Dilution with Domain-Scoped Retrieval
abstract:
arXiv:2606.11350v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) degrades when applied to large, heterogeneous document collections. In RAG systems, dense similarity becomes less discriminative, causing top-$k$ retrieval to return semantically similar but contextually incorrect chunks. We refer to this failure mode as vector search dilution. Even under hybrid dense+sparse retrieval, we first observed it in a deployed Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) system; in a controlled experiment, growing the corpus from 54 to 1,128 documents cut precision@10 by 63% and recall of the answer-bearing document by 23%. Similar patterns were observed in six other DOTs. To diagnose this issue, we introduce MASDR-RAG (Metadata-Scoped Domain Retrieval for RAG) as a controlled testbed over 200 human-validated queries, five LLM backbones, six public benchmark corpora, and two index stacks. In MASDR-RAG, domain scoping is the load-bearing component. We found hard partitioning to be unsafe, whereas training-free soft scoping is safe when the scope structure is real. Furthermore, we can discover these scopes without hand-curated metadata. However, multi-agent orchestration triggers a precision-faithfulness paradox that survives format controls, prompt controls, and blind human evaluation. Based on these varied outcomes, our practical recommendation is simple: soft-scope first, then perform a single synthesis call.
thinking: 该论文针对RAG系统在大规模异构文档集合中检索性能下降的问题，提出了向量搜索稀释的概念，并通过构建MASDR-RAG测试平台进行了系统性实证研究。其优势在于问题发现源于真实部署场景，并设计了严谨的对照实验；不足在于对多智能体编排引发的悖论问题尚未提供明确的解决方案。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，在大型文档库中使用RAG时，检索质量会因“向量搜索稀释”而下降，并验证了基于领域范围的软划分是有效的缓解策略。

title: Gauge-Invariant, Parameter-Insensitive Regularization for Potential Recovery from Flow on Directed Graphs
abstract:
arXiv:2607.13609v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Recovering a latent potential from observed flow on a directed graph (a discrete Poisson problem with Dirichlet boundaries) is ill-posed, and the standard fix backfires: ridge regularization shrinks toward a gauge-meaningless origin, collapsing and reversing the recovered ordering ($+0.81\to-0.42$ rank correlation against a planted ground truth). The gauge-invariant graph Dirichlet energy removes the hazard and delivers parameter-insensitivity: the estimate is stable across four orders of magnitude in $\lambda$, whereas ridge inverts the ordering for every $\lambda>0$. We prove the reduced solve is SPD and preserves dynamic range exactly where ridge collapses it, and localize absorbing boundaries from flow alone via a Poisson residual. The $H^1$ seminorm is classical; what is new is the gauge diagnosis, the parameter-insensitivity it buys, and an ablation showing the result is robust to the extraction method. On three public clickstream corpora the gauge-invariant estimate retains $28$--$41\%$ of the interior dynamic range while ridge collapses to as little as $0.2\%$. The same gauge invariance carries into graph neural networks -- neutralizing the constant mode per layer prevents the oversmoothing that collapses a deep directed GCN -- linking this classical inverse problem to a central question in graph learning.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种针对有向图上潜在势能恢复问题的正则化方法，解决了传统岭回归方法因规范依赖而导致的排序反转和动态范围崩溃问题。其方法在理论证明和多个公开点击流数据集上验证了有效性和参数不敏感性，技术新颖且论证严谨，但其在图情领域的直接业务落地场景尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种规范不变的正则化方法，能稳定地从有向图流量中恢复潜在势能排序，并防止深度图神经网络出现过平滑现象。

title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature
abstract:
arXiv:2608.27394v4 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction---zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address retrieves potential approaches for stated problems, Broaden retrieves more general formulations, and Specify retrieves concrete instantiations. RATIO is constructed from millions of full-text scientific papers across CS literature via a general recipe that extends discourse-marker distant supervision---previously used only for classification---to corpus-scale retrieval, combined with extensive LLM and human vetting. Experiments show that operation-specific fine-tuning substantially boosts retrievers and LLM reranking helps further, but much room for improvement remains. Researchers blind to condition found the fine-tuned retriever's candidates more useful as inspirations. RATIO provides a scalable training and evaluation framework for retrieval components that support literature-grounded ideation, opening up new research avenues in scientific inspiration retrieval. We release full data, code, models, and annotations.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个面向科学文献检索的基准数据集RATIO，其创新点在于将相关性定义为三种具体的构思操作，并通过大规模全文数据构建和严格的LLM与人工审核来确保质量。研究采用了前沿的远距离监督和LLM微调方法，技术前沿性高，但其业务落地价值目前主要体现在为检索系统研发提供评估框架，对图书馆等机构的直接应用场景尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个用于评估科学文献如何激发不同层次研究构思（如解决问题、拓宽思路、具体实现）的大规模检索基准数据集。

title: ARAFA: An LLM-Generated Arabic Fact-Checking Dataset
abstract:
arXiv:2609.25833v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Automatic fact-checking poses a significant challenge in Arabic natural language processing due to the scarcity of datasets and resources. In this manuscript, we introduce Arafa, a new large-scale dataset for fact-checking in Modern Standard Arabic, constructed through an automated framework leveraging large language models (LLMs). The dataset was constructed through a three-step pipeline: (1) claim generation from Arabic Wikipedia pages with supporting textual evidence, (2) claim mutation to generate challenging counterfactual claims with refuting evidence, and (3) an automatic validation step to validate that the generated claims are either supported or refuted by their accompanying evidence, or if the evidence does not provide enough information to judge the validity of the claims. The resulting dataset comprises 181,976 claim-evidence pairs labeled as supported, refuted, or not enough information. Human evaluation carried out on a test sample from the dataset demonstrated strong inter-annotator agreement (kappa = 0.89) using Cohen's Kappa for supported claims and (kappa = 0.94) for refuted claims. Automatic validation based on a human-evaluated sample achieved 86% accuracy for supported claims and 88% for refuted ones. To showcase Arafa's value as a resource for automatic Arabic fact-checking, four open-source transformer-based models were fine-tuned using Arafa, with the top-performing model achieving a Macro F1-score of 77% on the test data. In addition to Arafa being the first large-scale dataset for Arabic fact-checking, our framework presents a scalable approach for developing similar resources for other low-resource languages.
thinking: 论文采用大语言模型自动构建阿拉伯语事实核查数据集，技术方法具有前沿性；其生成的公开数据集可直接用于阿拉伯语NLP任务，实践价值显著；方法上采用了多步骤自动化流程并辅以人工评估验证，严谨性较好，但自动验证准确率尚有提升空间。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究利用大语言模型自动构建了首个大规模阿拉伯语事实核查数据集，并验证了其用于训练模型的可行性。

title: Following the Flow the Law Requires: Training Voice Agents to Transfer to Unseen Regulated Procedures in Debt Collection
abstract:
arXiv:2610.18881v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Voice agents built on large language models (LLMs) now handle customer calls, but in regulated applications completing the task is not enough: the agent must follow a conversational flow set by law. In debt collection, it must confirm it is speaking to the debtor before mentioning the debt, identify itself and the creditor, state the amount, and avoid prohibited language. Every creditor turns these rules into its own procedure and revises it. We ask whether a small, self-hosted policy can be trained once and then follow regulated procedures it has never seen. One machine-readable specification per deployment, FlowSpec, generates the policy instruction, gates the tools, supplies the supervision and defines the tests; the agent speaks only approved catalogue sentences. We fine-tune a 9-billion-parameter model on 2,506 conversations from 297 randomized procedures and evaluate a Thai outbound-call agent on four unseen deployment procedures (three debt collection, one non-debt), one from a wholly withheld lineage. Documented checks, fixed by the procedure, rise from 67--71 percents to 93--100 percents, while grounded checks, fixed by the conversation, already pass at 97--100 percents before training; scenario pass rate rises from 15/43 to 40/43. An audit of the shared specification finds 11 defects, 3 of which its own metric did not expose.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于受监管场景下语音代理的合规性训练，采用小规模自托管策略和结构化规范（FlowSpec）实现对新流程的快速适应，在方法上具有创新性和严谨性。其研究直接针对债务催收等高度规范化的业务流程，落地价值明确，但技术核心仍是对现有LLM的微调与应用，前沿性相对有限。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种方法，能让语音代理通过一次训练，就能自动遵循其从未见过的、法律规定的债务催收对话流程。

title: From Qualitative Text to Integrated Evidence: The Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI) Procedure
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19164v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Mixed methods research offers established strategies for integrating qualitative and quantitative evidence, but less guidance for integrating two computational representations of the same qualitative corpus. This methodological study introduces Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI), a four-step procedure for explicit and traceable integration. We present PTI using 1,203 interview paragraphs from 29 mothers in Nepal. The two representations were ontology-guided Patient Voice (PV) coding with PVminer and data-driven themes generated through non-negative matrix factorization (NMF). A theme-complete crosswalk documented convergence, divergence, and preprocessing-sensitive differences. Depression status, based on Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) scores, served as a secondary external anchor for exploratory association checks. PTI provides a structured approach for integrating computational representations of qualitative text within mixed methods research.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种整合定性文本计算表征的混合方法研究流程，在方法论层面具有创新性，并使用了非负矩阵分解等计算方法。然而，作为预印本，其方法严谨性尚未经过同行评议的充分检验，且其应用场景（尼泊尔母亲的访谈分析）较为具体，在图情领域的直接实践价值有待进一步转化。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一种名为PTI的四步法，用于在混合方法研究中整合对同一质性文本的两种不同计算表征。

title: Whose Data, Whose Benchmark? A User-Centric Framework for Auditing Evaluation Resources
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19268v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Benchmarks shape how model capabilities are measured and interpreted, yet their scores can obscure whose conventions, contexts, and judgments define successful performance. We introduce a user-centric audit framework that distinguishes users who contribute benchmark content from those whose needs evaluation results are intended to represent. The framework operationalizes seven dimensions across benchmark content, metadata, documentation, and scoring procedures. Across 16 resources, we find that American-centered conventions account for 62.4-94.4% of matched signals in 11 text benchmarks, while geographic visibility in five image-text resources is concentrated and strongly associated with national GDP share (mean Pearson r = 0.780; Spearman p = 0.778). Documentation reveals a systematic source-target gap: all 16 resources operationalize source-user context, but none operationalize target-user context. Paired scoring experiments further show that meaning-preserving answer variants reduce DROP exact-match accuracy from 100.0% to 33.3%, while TruthfulQA exhibits metric-dependent reductions in reference similarity. Our framework and documentation checklist make user assumptions auditable, clarifying what benchmark scores represent and where evaluation claims are supported.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种用户中心的基准审计框架，从内容、元数据、文档和评分程序七个维度系统评估了16个NLP基准资源，揭示了其中存在显著的地域偏见和用户上下文缺口。其方法论严谨，通过量化分析和配对实验验证了问题，但研究主要聚焦于揭示问题本身，在具体如何修正基准或指导模型开发方面的落地路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个审计框架，发现主流AI基准测试存在显著的地域偏见，并普遍缺乏对目标用户背景的考量。

title: GraphRAG-LTM: A Layered Threat Modeling Framework for Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19549v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) uses document-derived knowledge graphs to assemble evidence for large language model (LLM) answers. Its security depends on both the seed chunks retrieved for a query and the graph evidence assembled from them, yet attacks on this evidence path remain underexplored. We introduce GraphRAG-LTM, a Layered Threat Modeling framework that tests three nested levels of attacker access. BB Query uses ranking feedback to make query edits under a semantic-similarity constraint and demote relevant seed chunks. WB Query uses retriever gradients for the same objective. Graph-aware WB keeps the white-box adversarial query and deletes bridge triplets from the query-specific evidence graph, disrupting multi-hop evidence propagation through localized graph edits. Across datasets, retrievers, and LLM backbones, rank feedback alone reduces answer quality, gradient access strengthens query attacks, and bridge-triplet deletion further impairs supporting-fact retrieval. Further analyses show how seed retrieval and graph evidence jointly contribute to these failures.
thinking: 该论文针对图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）这一前沿技术，系统性地提出了一个分层威胁建模框架，并设计了三种不同攻击权限的攻击方法，填补了该领域安全研究的空白。研究在多个数据集、检索器和LLM骨干网络上进行了实验验证，方法设计严谨，但作为预印本论文，其结论尚未经过同行评议的最终检验。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个针对图检索增强生成系统的分层威胁模型，揭示了系统在查询攻击和证据图编辑下的安全脆弱性。

title: Beyond Reachability: A Relation-Semantic Reasoning Framework for Biomedical Multi-hop QA
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19754v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Biomedical multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs requires identifying a semantically valid relation sequence that supports the answer. Existing methods can retrieve correct answers, yet often rank them poorly within a large pool of seemingly relevant candidates. Even when a correct answer is retrieved, its associated evidence and reasoning path may fail to support the relation composition required by the question. We term this disconnect between answer reachability and evidential validity the reachable-but-invalid problem. We present ReSemReason, which shares a question-induced distribution over typed, directed relation schemas between candidate discovery and evidence selection. Schema compatibility guides graph search; ReSemAttn then uses relation-conditioned key/value projections and an uncertainty-weighted path prior to attend to candidate-specific evidence. A separate absolute-support score complements normalized attention when all retrieved paths are weak. The reported experiments on BioHopR, PrimeKGQA, and MedReason show improvements in answer ranking and answer-set quality. Path-discrimination analyses examine the distinction between endpoint correctness and evidential support. We also specify matched controls for search, attention, and schema uncertainty.
thinking: 该论文提出了一种基于关系语义推理的生物医学多跳问答框架，通过引入类型化关系模式分布和不确定性加权路径先验，有效解决了答案可达性与证据有效性脱节的问题。方法设计较为严谨，在多个生物医学知识图谱数据集上验证了性能提升，但技术前沿性主要体现在对现有图推理方法的优化，而非颠覆性创新。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一个新的推理框架，通过协调答案发现与证据选择，提升了生物医学知识图谱问答中答案排序和证据路径的有效性。

title: A Strong Harness Narrows the Model Gap: A Comparative Evaluation for Legislative Document-to-XML Conversion
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19999v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Legal-content reproduction requires matching the source exactly in section hierarchy, verbatim text, citations, and amendment spans; a dropped citation or mislabeled amendment carries into the products lawyers rely on. We report an industrial pipeline converting U.S. state legislation into strict, schema-constrained XML, and hypothesize that its accuracy comes from harness engineering, the deterministic tooling built around a model, more than the model itself. Our controlled ablation crosses three harnesses (zero-shot, a single tool-using agent, and a decomposed multi-agent pipeline) with three Claude models on 153 gold bills from two jurisdictions. The harness narrows the model gap: the weakest model in the full pipeline beats the strongest model alone (0.948 versus 0.806, paired bootstrap p less than 0.001). Because the two agentic harnesses share identical tools, their gap comes from orchestration: decomposition plus the persisted state and per-agent context it brings. Across four scored dimensions, the model spread at zero-shot (0.68 to 0.81) narrows to 0.95 at the full pipeline; the residual sits almost entirely in citation normalization, where the canonical identifier is retrieved from an external authority rather than generated from the weights, so a deterministic lookup tool supplies the exactness that a larger model does not.
thinking: 该论文聚焦于法律文档的精准结构化转换，通过构建包含确定性工具的多智能体流程来提升XML生成质量，方法设计严谨且具有明确的工业应用背景。研究在技术前沿性上展示了智能体工程与大型语言模型的结合应用，但核心创新更多体现在流程设计而非底层模型突破。
one_sentence_summary: 研究发现，围绕大模型构建包含确定性工具和分解流程的工程框架，比单纯使用更强大的模型更能精准地将法律文件转换为结构化XML。

title: Sparse Autoencoders for Mechanistic Interpretability in NLP: A Critical Survey of Recoverability, Interpretability, and Utility
abstract:
arXiv:2610.20139v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising approach to mechanistic interpretability by decomposing language-model activations into sparse, potentially interpretable features. However, differences in design assumptions, evaluation objectives, and experimental settings complicate conclusions about their effectiveness. We present a critical survey of 138 studies on SAEs in natural language processing. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we propose a task-grounded taxonomy connecting dictionary design, feature operations, and NLP functions; (2) we examine how sparsity allocation, geometry, data coverage, and inference affect feature recoverability; (3) we assess evidence for semantic interpretability, mechanistic faithfulness, and behavioral utility; and (4) we synthesize findings across multilingual processing, retrieval, reasoning, classification, and behavioral regulation, highlighting the roles of objectives, baselines, supervision, and intervention pipelines. Through comparative analyses of published results, we reconcile apparent disagreements, identify unresolved questions, and propose directions for more rigorous evaluation. An anonymous research register https://anonymous.4open.science/r/sae-research-register-C331/register.html accompanies the survey.
thinking: 该论文对稀疏自编码器在NLP可解释性领域的138项研究进行了系统性综述，提出了任务导向的分类框架并评估了特征可恢复性、可解释性和效用证据，方法严谨且覆盖全面。但作为综述性研究，其前沿技术度主要体现在对新兴方法的评估而非原创技术贡献，且对图书馆业务的实际落地价值较为间接。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文系统梳理了稀疏自编码器在自然语言处理可解释性研究中的应用现状、评估挑战与未来方向。

title: Plant Memory: Technical Language Processing and a Verified Maintenance Ontology for Agent-Accessible Failure Knowledge from SAP PM Work Orders
abstract:
arXiv:2610.19131v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Maintenance work orders are the largest written record of how industrial equipment fails, yet in most plants they are close to unusable for analysis. Short texts are abbreviated and misspelt, asset identity is buried in free text, work-type labels contradict the work described, and the fields that matter most for reliability (symptom, root cause, action taken) are usually empty. As a result, diagnostic knowledge stays with senior technicians and leaves when they do. We present Plant Memory, a system that applies technical language processing (TLP) to SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) exports and builds an ISO 14224-aligned maintenance ontology in which every extracted statement is a reified fact carrying a confidence score, the evidence it was read from, and a verification state. Extraction is rule-first, with an optional large language model (LLM) acting as a second reader whose disagreements raise a fact's review priority rather than overwrite it. Technicians verify facts through a review queue, answer targeted knowledge-gap questions where failures repeat without a recorded cause, and approve or reject ontology drift proposals when new terms appear. The resulting graph is served to people through a web application and to AI agents through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so both query the same verified knowledge and every answer cites the work orders behind it. On a synthetic 12-month export of 400 work orders from a parboiled-rice plant, rule-based extraction reaches 96.2% component accuracy, 88.9% failure-mode accuracy and 100% root-cause precision at 62% coverage; on 28 diagnostic questions, ranked root causes from the ontology are correct at top-1 in 82.1% of cases against 53.6% for the raw SAP root-cause column.
thinking: 该论文结合技术语言处理和本体构建，针对工业维护工单的知识提取与验证提出了系统化方法，并引入大语言模型作为辅助验证工具，技术前沿性较强。研究设计了完整的验证流程和评估指标，在合成数据集上展示了较高的准确率，方法严谨且具有明确的工业应用场景。但论文主要基于合成数据，在真实复杂环境中的泛化能力有待进一步验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究构建了一个从混乱的工业维护工单中自动提取、验证并构建可信知识图谱的系统，使隐性维修知识得以留存和利用。

title: On Challenges in Evaluation Methodology: A Review
abstract:
arXiv:2604.25923v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Recent advances in language models have prompted a growing body of work that questions prevailing evaluation practices. However, many such critiques have already been discussed in natural language processing (NLP), a field with a long history of methodological reflection on evaluation. We conduct a scoping review spanning four decades and develop a taxonomy of 22 recurring concerns. For each concern, we examine how recently it was discussed in the reviewed literature and whether it receives explicit attention in institutional checklists, finding that some concerns have become less visible in literature and many lack coverage in these checklists. Our work provides an overview of the major concerns in evaluation methodology that have shaped the field and identifies potential targets for renewed investigation and field-level intervention by the research community.
thinking: 该论文通过系统综述方法，梳理了自然语言处理领域四十年来关于评估方法的22类核心关切，具有扎实的方法论基础和历史纵深感。其优势在于构建了清晰的分类体系并揭示了部分关切在近期文献和机构指南中被忽视的现象，但研究本身是对现有文献的归纳分析，未提出新的前沿技术或直接的业务落地方案。
one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文系统回顾了自然语言处理领域评估方法中长期存在的22类问题，并指出其中部分问题在当前研究和指导原则中被忽视了。

title: ProReviewer: Evidence-Driven Investigation for Scientific Peer Review
abstract:
arXiv:2606.13349v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Effective peer review requires adaptive investigation that responds to evidence emerging from each paper. Existing LLM-based reviewers largely organize the review process around predefined workflows, leaving limited scope for emerging evidence to reshape investigation. We propose ProReviewer, an evidence-driven review agent that formulates reviewing as a Markov Decision Process, with a structured review log forming the core of its state. At each step, the agent uses accumulated findings to decide what to inspect next and when to conclude. As new evidence emerges, it updates the log by revising claim statuses, resolving open questions, and recording new findings. Each point in the final review cites supporting log entries, making its judgments traceable to the recorded evidence. On 1,000 held-out ICLR 2026 papers, the trained 8B ProReviewer achieves the highest average score among all compared methods, including those built on a 397B model; human evaluators prefer its reviews over all baselines on three of four review-quality dimensions.
thinking: 论文提出了一种基于马尔可夫决策过程的证据驱动同行评审智能体，将大语言模型与动态决策流程结合，在技术方法上具有显著的前沿性。其基于1000篇论文的评估和人工评价结果，验证了方法的有效性，但作为概念验证研究，其在实际学术出版流程中的落地应用路径尚不明确。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究开发了一个能根据证据动态调整审查步骤的AI评审员，其生成的评审意见在多项质量维度上优于现有基线方法。

title: ANCHOR-RE: An Agentic Biomedical Relation Extraction Framework with Retrieval Augmentation and Error-Driven Verification
abstract:
arXiv:2608.03154v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Biomedical relation extraction (BioRE) supports knowledge graph construction and hypothesis generation. In real-world settings, most candidate entity pairs are unrelated. Symbolic systems such as SemRep offer high precision and interpretability but limited recall, whereas large language models (LLMs) can produce false-positive relations. We developed ANCHOR-RE, an agentic framework that combines retrieved demonstrations, ontology-guided semantic constraints, external biomedical knowledge, and error-driven verification to improve BioRE reliability without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluated ANCHOR-RE on SemRepGS, DDI, and ChemProt using proprietary and open-weight LLMs. To assess generalizability while reducing potential pretraining contamination, we also conducted a post-cutoff temporal precision evaluation using 100 biomedical articles published in 2026. With the proprietary backbone, ANCHOR-RE improved micro-F1 over direct prompting from 0.654 to 0.676 on SemRepGS, from 0.769 to 0.881 on DDI, and from 0.937 to 0.941 on ChemProt, outperforming previously reported inference-only methods on DDI and ChemProt. Gains were also observed with the open-weight backbone. Additional experiments demonstrated cross-family model compatibility and sensitivity to external knowledge quality. Manual assessment of 500 randomly sampled positive predictions from the post-cutoff set yielded 69% precision. These results show that contextual evidence and error-driven verification can improve BioRE reliability across benchmarks, model families, and newly published literature, supporting ANCHOR-RE as a practical training-free approach to biomedical literature mining.
thinking: 论文提出了一种结合检索增强与错误驱动验证的智能体框架，用于提升生物医学关系抽取的可靠性，方法设计具有创新性且实验验证较为全面。但其前沿性主要体现在对现有LLM技术的集成优化，而非提出全新模型；实践价值受限于生物医学领域的专业性，方法严谨性因使用未来文献（2026年）进行验证而存在一定争议。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出一种无需训练的新框架，通过整合外部知识和错误验证，有效提升了大型语言模型在生物医学文献中抽取关系的准确性和可靠性。

title: BTS-AgentBench: A Deterministic, Replayable Pipeline from Read-Only Telemetry Logs to Agent Benchmarks
abstract:
arXiv:2608.27334v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Operational facilities accumulate extensive local telemetry, but agent-ready interactive evaluations with source-verifiable answers are costly to construct from such archives. Site-specific measurement histories also motivate a local conversion workflow that can operate where raw operational data must remain under organizational control. We introduce BTS-AgentBench, a deterministic compiler that transforms read-only telemetry and equipment metadata into tool-backed, multi-turn agent tasks, phase-level targets, evidence and executable evaluation contracts. The BTS release includes 532 episodes across nine families; a second-corpus port produces 204 XAI4HEAT episodes. Frozen-input replay reproduces released artifacts byte-for-byte, and independent raw-source checks cover all 89 BTS and 41 XAI4HEAT test episodes. Replayable provenance links 1,170 trial identities to recorded execution and scorer conditions, while 1,125 completed traces retain model responses and tool results. An obligation-level comparison of 216 scored failures found that linked records exposed additional recorded failed obligations in 202 cases (93.5\%), including tool arguments, stream identity, state carryover and missing interaction steps. The pipeline thereby supports source-grounded task generation, exact reconstruction and auditable diagnosis of agent executions. Code, released benchmarks, and reproduction instructions are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/telemetry-benchmark-reproduction-3D68
thinking: 该论文提出了一种将操作遥测日志转化为可复现智能体基准测试的确定性编译流程，在方法严谨性上表现突出，通过字节级复现和独立验证确保了结果的可信度。然而，论文技术核心在于数据处理与基准构建的工程化流程，而非前沿的智能体算法本身，且其应用场景（如特定设施监控）较为专一，限制了其直接、广泛的业务落地价值。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究设计了一套能将操作日志自动转化为可严格复现的智能体测试任务与评估合约的确定性编译流程。

title: Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing
abstract:
arXiv:2609.38427v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.
thinking: 该论文提出了一个基于政策条件的AI使用检测框架，将AI检测从简单的文本分类问题转变为对工作流程合规性的可审计评估，在方法论上具有创新性。其优势在于将政策规则显式化，并强调可解释的证据、校准和错误率控制，为学术出版机构提供了可操作的实施路径；不足之处在于框架的实际部署依赖于出版机构对结构化披露、工具路由等基础设施的投入，其大规模应用的有效性尚待验证。
one_sentence_summary: 该研究提出了一个将出版政策作为输入条件的AI使用检测框架，旨在评估人机协作流程的合规性，而非简单判断文本来源。

title: Learning Reusable Agent Subroutines from Experience
abstract:
arXiv:2606.02994v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Existing methods induce various forms of knowledge from agent traces, from sample workflows to programmatic skills. We propose ARISE (Agent Routine Induction from Successful Experience), which identifies recurring procedures in agent traces and synthesizes them into a reusable library of agent subroutines. Across five tasks in narrative deduction, rule application, and constraint planning, it is shown to be a more effective learning strategy than prompting methods and prose and code artifact induction methods. ARISE outperforms chain-of-thought in all ten model-task settings of the main evaluation. Compared to state-of-the-art methods in agent experience induction, our method scores 6.1 percentage points over the strongest evaluated baselines, and 11.5 percentage points over code-skill induction. In our controlled experiment, ARISE also improves average accuracy by up to 15.6 percentage points compared to formatting the induced knowledge as skills and by up to 19.1 points over rewriting it as code tools.

title: AVA-Encoder: Towards Agent-Native Video Representation Learning
abstract:
arXiv:2608.12313v3 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Agentic video creation systems remain far from cinematic-grade quality: their underlying models struggle to plan how story, characters, visuals, and sound fit together, and high-quality creation trajectories to learn such planning abilities are scarce. Finished human films embody this knowledge, but in a tightly coupled audiovisual form that agents cannot directly read or manipulate. We propose the Agentic Video Auto-Encoder (AVA-Encoder), which works backward from finished films, turning them into agent-native representations with reconstruction itself as supervision. It encodes a film into a Film Knowledge Graph (Film KG) of structured-text nodes, typed dependency edges, and linked multimodal assets, then regenerates the film from this graph with a fixed decoder. Reconstruction residuals are distilled into textual gradients that drive dual-loop self-evolution: an outer loop learns a shared encoding policy across videos, and an inner loop refines each video's Film KG at test time. AVA-Encoder improves reconstruction fidelity by 20.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline; its learned policy outperforms a finely human-tuned policy with over 70 percent fewer system-prompt tokens; and Film KGs support coordinated editing and improve all tested downstream creation systems. We release the framework, a reconstruction benchmark, and a Film KG dataset.

title: Do you "see" what I "see"? A Multi-panel Visual Question Answer Dataset for Large Language Model Chart Analysis
abstract:
arXiv:2610.14173v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Digital libraries increasingly host scientific publications whose figures encode primary research findings, yet making this visual content searchable, accessible, and reusable remains an open challenge. Large language and multimodal models (LLMs/LMMs) provide the possibility to automate many figure parsing tasks such as determining data trends or extracting data from plots. In this work, we consider if these models can reliably support task-oriented visual data analysis when presented with synthetic, but realistic, scientific figures that contain multiple charts. Our Visual Question Answering (VQA) process scaffolds our tasks along a four-level description model from basic conceptual answers to interpretive and analytical understanding. Additionally, we outline our process for synthetically generating our single and multi-panel (charts in which there are multiple panels present) plots and testing the data with various LMMs using quantitative analysis. In general, we find LMMs become less accurate with increasing figure complexity as the number of panels, number of plot elements, and difficulty of questions increase. Finally, because LMM accuracy is expected to change rapidly, our analysis also considers cost relative to performance as a metric to inform future user decisions. We provide the detailed question-answer pairs used in this analysis, along with the code used to generate random plots, question-answer pairs and detailed bounding-box metadata for chart elements. The code and data are available at https://github.com/ReadingTimeMachine/LLM_VQA_MultiPanel and https://huggingface.co/datasets/ReadingTimeMachine/visual\_qa\_multipanel
thinking: 该论文针对数字图书馆中科学图表的多模态理解问题，构建了一个多面板视觉问答数据集，并系统评估了大语言/多模态模型的性能，方法设计严谨且数据开源。其核心贡献在于为前沿的LMM图表分析任务提供了基准工具，但研究结论（模型性能随复杂度下降）本身较为直观，且作为预印本尚未经过同行评议的完整检验。
